body:
Solidarity is the antidote.
#
Yesterday, the GOP-led House met and passed its first bill of 2025: to ban transgender girls and women from girls’ sports.
The same people who opposed the Violence Against Women Act and attacked women's rights across the country are now pretending to care about women to target trans girls and endanger _all_ of our rights. **GTFO**.
Meanwhile, L.A. is on fire and **the #1 priority Republicans have in Congress right now are attacking trans kids in sports**.
This is their plan: to divide and distract us, so they can loot the public coffers while everyone argues over scraps.
**Solidarity is the antidote**. Do not let them divide us.
I stand with the trans community now and always. Trans girls are girls. **Period**. 🏳️⚧️ ✌🏽
In solidarity,
Alexandria

Listen, Team, we know that the election's long over. But post-election polling has consistently shown two things: That people voted to show their displeasure economically, and that voters don't truly know what is in the agenda put forward by the candidate that won .
That's why we keep spreading the word about Project 2025 -- the extremist Heritage Foundation's plan to reshape America, especially after Project 2025's authors have been given prominent positions in the upcoming administration -- and "Agenda 47" -- which is a close parallel that Trump's campaign used as their blueprint for the future.
Both plans are a danger to our democracy. We need your help to spread the word.
It's on us, Team, to make sure people know what's at stake and what bills and initiatives may be coming that will impact their ability to vote. One of the central tenets of Trump’s Agenda 47 is securing the nation’s elections: “ We will implement measures to secure our Elections, including Voter ID, highly sophisticated paper ballots, proof of Citizenship, and same day Voting. We will not allow the Democrats to give Voting Rights to illegal Aliens ,” the agenda says.
Let's be clear -- no one is advocating for illegal aliens to vote. Voter ID has been proven again and again to be a suppressive deterrent to voting in multiple studies. Non-citizen voting has been against the law for decades, and despite the millions of taxpayer dollars that have been spent searching for voter fraud, very few problems have been found -- 20 formerly incarcerated voters who voted in 2020 when they weren't yet eligible to vote again in Florida, for example, or the Trump voter who filled out his deceased mother's mail-in-ballot in Pennsylvania.
But those 20 votes didn't change anything among Florida's 13 million eligible voters, nor did that one ballot have an impact with Pennsylvania's 9 million voters. And none of the issues found in these elections showed any non-citizen voting. This is an entire agenda concocted to control our elections and codify their power for the future , not to address any real problems.

subject: Looking ahead

body:
https://jenaforcolorado.com [https://jenaforcolorado.com]
Friends,
As Colorado's Secretary of State, I’ve had the honor of fighting for our democracy and ensuring every Colorado voter can make their voice heard.
Since taking office in 2019, I’ve worked tirelessly to expand access to the ballot box and protect our elections. We’ve increased the number of mail ballot drop boxes across the state, expanded in-person voting, guaranteed voting access on every public college campus and tribal land, and launched a statewide system so voters can track their ballots every step of the way.
Democracy faced unprecedented challenges in 2020—and the threats haven’t stopped. As Chair of the Democratic Association of Secretaries of State, I’ve led the charge to ensure election deniers don’t take control of battleground states. Together, we’ve stood firm against attacks on our democratic institutions, proving that truth and justice can prevail when we unite.
Now, with another Trump presidency and ongoing efforts to undermine our freedoms, the stakes couldn’t be higher. Colorado’s progress, resilience, and commitment to equality must serve as a beacon of hope for the rest of the nation.
This fight isn’t just about elections—it’s about the core values we share: freedom, dignity, and the belief that every voice matters. It’s about safeguarding the rights generations before us fought to secure and ensuring our children inherit a democracy as strong as ever.
Thank you for supporting me thus far, and thank you for being with us in the fight to preserve and protect our democracy.
Jena Griswold

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Peter,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

It's a voice America needs | | | | FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW | | Peter,I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns. As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be. I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust. The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored. The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way. The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun. A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly. # Join Us in Supporting Altadena Fire Victims
---
[](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=d89c722a83&e=7b1b739a89)
| Dear Friends,
I hope this message finds you well. I want to share a heartbreaking story about a family affected by the recent Eaton Fire in Altadena and invite you to join us in our efforts to help them and others in need.
The Sawyer Family's Struggle
Lydia Sawyer, her husband Tom, and their elderly uncle Richard have lived in their home for nearly 40 years. Tragically, they lost everything in the fire, including the memories and stability they had built for their three grandchildren, whom they are raising. As Lydia stood before the charred remains of their home, she struggled to hold back tears, knowing that she would have to explain this devastating loss to the children. To add to their heartbreak, their insurance won’t cover their losses due to a missed payment.
How You Can Help
This Sunday, January 19th, from 12 PM to 3 PM, I am partnering with Hon. Chris Holden, the Hospital Association of Southern California, and Hope the Mission to host a donation drive for families like the Sawyers. We are also inviting the Sawyer family to the event to provide them with direct financial assistance that day.
_Donation Drive Details:_
_\- Date: Sunday, January 19th_
_\- Time: 12 PM - 3 PM_
_\- Location: Pasadena Unified School District_
_351 S Hudson Street, Pasadena, CA 91101_
We are collecting essential items such as blankets, clothes, diapers, hygiene products, pet food and more. If you would like to provide financial support, please donate using this [link](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=b98e56961e&e=7b1b739a89) or button below:
Your support can make a significant difference during this difficult time. Together, we can bring hope and assistance to those who need it most.
Thank you for your generosity.
Sincerely,
Asif

Donald Trump, House Speaker Mike Johnson, and the rest of the MAGA delegation is turning the California wildfires into a political opportunity to ram through their massive tax cuts and balloon the deficit.

While people mourn lost loved ones, MAGA celebrates opportunity.

While families pick through the burnt rubble of their homes, MAGA takes advantage of their disaster.

[Donate to Humanity First USA](https://substack.com/redirect/ec86ac6d-f5c4-4056-bedb-5b9bbc1b5884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
This week, I led a team of Humanity First USA lawyers and volunteers to set up a legal support booth for victims of the devastating LA fires. Over the course of just a few days, we've already served dozens of families. We expect many more to arrive throughout the coming days and weeks for legal support and counsel.
Each story we heard is a heartbreaking reminder of why we must remain relentless in our service to humanity. We met families who lost everything--homes reduced to ash, treasured belongings gone forever. Some didn't know where they would sleep once their insurance money ran out. Others were already receiving predatory calls urging them to sell their properties at a fraction of their value. Too many were being shortchanged by insurance companies, left to navigate a confusing and often unjust system. Here's a snapshot of those stories that I feel compelled to share.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/baaa8b60-d8c6-482e-8211-ffde91814873?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Standing with the local NAACP in Pasadena as we prepare to assist LA fire victims
We counseled Jamal, a small business owner desperate to get back to work. His shop burned down, and he sought legal counsel on how to ensure his equipment and supplies would not be excluded from coverage. Given that his business included carpet cleaning and restoration from smoke damage, every moment it took for the insurance company to approve his claim meant lost resources.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/001b7af0-94f3-4283-9ba5-748d2b3b7149?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Los Angeles based attorney Amjad Khan speaking with a small business owner on how to protect his property and economic security.
We met Danielle. Her and her husband's home was ravaged with fire and smoke damage, but thankfully still standing. Yet, she approached us not for herself, but to assist a neighboring family who had endured the unimaginable: losing their father unexpectedly, only to see their home destroyed by the Eaton fire just weeks later. We were able to guide her and her neighbor on how to best protect themselves from a denied claim, maximize their owed benefits, and how to ensure their FEMA claims are processed properly.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8c6e95e5-ece0-413b-882a-526fbbc8475f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then there was Lana, an artist who had spent decades building her career, painstakingly creating a body of work she could be proud of. Most of her prized pieces were destroyed in the fire, leaving her not just grieving but also wondering how to rebuild? We were struck by her resilience in the face of adversity, and her commitment to continue to push forward despite seemingly losing everything. Her faith in herself was truly inspiring, and a reminder of how much strength each of us have within us, even when facing the loss of our life's work.
Some stories were still truly depressing. For example, I met and counseled Tony, who voluntarily shared that he was undocumented. Tony's landlord committed fraud by filing a FEMA claim under Tony's mother's name without her knowledge and consent. Tony felt that his landlord was exploiting his immigration status for personal financial gain, knowing Tony would hesitate to report to the authorities. Our team advised him on how to file a claim of fraud and protect his rights in the aftermath of this blatant exploitation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ad398800-bf1d-4fb9-ac55-6a43740ff8c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We didn't ask these families for proof of financial hardship. We didn't inquire about their political affiliation, their religion. And we did not ask about their immigration status. We didn't make these asks because that's not what service to humanity looks like. Instead, we served everyone who came to us, and will continue to serve everyone we can, because human rights are sacred and inherent. Indeed, the measure of our society is how we treat one another in times of crisis. This week has been a humbling reminder that all of us are just one tragedy away from homelessness, from losing a loved one, from having to start over. And that is why we must always look out for one another.
Our work was immensely enhanced in partnership with the NAACP of Pasadena, who graciously offered their office space and resources to help us in our mission. We were also supported by [Muslim Youth USA](https://substack.com/redirect/66502a17-fde6-4d22-9452-fb4913d4474c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), whose mission statement is, "_Serving the communities we live in isn't just a civic responsibility, it's the most important part of our faith_." Finally, we met with FEMA and Red Cross leadership to ensure they knew our legal services were available, and were grateful for their gracious and ongoing support.
As the fires continue to blaze, we remain committed to providing legal aid, resources, and support to all who need it. Service to humanity is service to _all_ humanity, without exception. If these stories resonate with you, I invite you to join our efforts. Your support--whether through a charitable contribution or by sharing this article--allows us to stay on the ground, helping those who need it most.
[Donate to Humanity First USA](https://substack.com/redirect/ec86ac6d-f5c4-4056-bedb-5b9bbc1b5884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Together, we can ensure that no one faces these tragedies alone. Together, we can build a more perfect union. Thank you all for your continued trust, donations, support, and partnership to elevate each other's humanity. As always, I welcome your subscription to _Let 's Address This_ as we continue to advocate for absolute justice and universal human rights.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z91e9pp14cm41b39rc80qn4i1p1v1ng292kubn4o_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cph2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqqh6ok4gtj34t9mp28a7qrm4ggbeutmdirs964o_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cph2bs).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z4jts9gj9p7mmosqcvsmlq43beoecs28obdvrcso_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cph2bs)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2znt9sv3qjt42bec3tjnr8jf67obft5lhqllnq7b8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cph2bs)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---

**_CNN: “[Republicans] will oversee _narrowest_ House majority in nearly 100 years” _**

Trust me, I understand just how much time, effort, and resources from hardworking Americans like YOU went into securing such a big victory this November.

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: You'll want this in your home in 2025
body:
Please -- for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpeivddm0fg3om4ts3qf3gmg5h4usr5k21533fm8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2cfkafbhvo0aa5ajic236c3ll70j8k7bltgp6bo_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjc4tcg2ddgrkslp5puen8u2fvtdcng96jmeh9b8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb4omsn71aidv5dlssnf6hb414ltqr4aj5ul8vq0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfbqd94fkaqk0sbk2dffj72fucprt5sbg0msfp6g_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---

---

The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart -- maybe even yours -- is to support the very first children's television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[**Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z553kfi5tucdulc85ft3hniev6ubmi78i6ujok88_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1i61o34cth2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

subject: Brand-new kid's book "The 10 Commandments for Kids"
body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life.

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zcptqm2grt7puf001pfv13ab6cko6qt0j3flqqjg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h68or6cjh2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zkj8ntut5u9cvdpb6uru2ukf1g48r3rpigo26kk0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h68or6cjh2bs)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ztico527plarllefe491h63li2frhcosar34b6fo_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h68or6cjh2bs)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
Two years of fighting could be for *nothing* in just two short months.

Two years of fighting could be for *nothing* in just two short months.
| **_AN EMERGENCY BRIEFING FROM THE DESK OF JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend:
---
I’m not one to raise the alarm without good reason, so I hope you’ll spare just a moment to hear me out.
---
I’ve received word that the Democrats’ midterm plan to STEAL the majority now hinges on this inescapable reality:
---
**_CNN: “[Republicans] will oversee _narrowest_ House majority in nearly 100 years” _**
---
And now, the Democrats know they’ll get their chance to crack our “narrow” majority in just a few short months...
---
**It’s a simple calculus: With multiple special elections on the books for early this year, the “narrowest majority in a century” could __already__ fall to a mere _TOSS-UP_.**
---
After such a historic victory in November, the Left is hoping, begging, that we’ll rest on our laurels and become complacent so that they can **FLIP** the majority! _We cannot let that happen. Period._
---
That’s why I’ve prepared this briefing to urge every America First patriot to keep their eyes peeled. Don’t let the Radical Democrats take advantage of this feeling of victory.
---

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: SIGN NOW: Calling for the housing we need in Dallas / FIRMA AHORA: Llamamos por la vivienda que necesitamos en Dallas
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
ADD YOUR NAME:
Speak up for tenants' rights in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20justice%202024.jpg]
The housing crisis in Dallas continues to worsen. Rent prices are rising faster than wages, evictions for some residents are happening without notice or cause, and housing instability is on the rise.
From collapsing ceilings due to water damage to routine water shutoffs, countless tenants are living with poor maintenance and broken promises from landlords — and many fear retaliation if they speak up. Despite this, current laws at the local and state levels offer little protection or support for renters. We're pushing for change!
TOP's housing justice organizing is rooted in our fundamental belief that housing is a human right, and that all in our communities deserve a safe, affordable, and stable place to call home — no matter our age, race, gender, faith, or income.
ADD YOUR NAME if you're a Dallas resident who agrees, and who wants to plug in to this vital campaign work! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7xt9JezgWm3pil3PMcC1HyJVOTPmsxZdMxZkerJcMqS02WQ/viewform]
For more information, email Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Another arctic blast is on the way
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Arctic%20blast%20Texas.png]
Another blast of arctic air will make its way to Texas at the tailend of this weekend, as our state once again braces for dangerously cold temperatures. Climate change is the culprit behind these more frequent blasts of cold in the United States.
Learn more about the weather development here. [https://www.newsweek.com/dangerously-cold-arctic-air-january-forecast-map-2014553]
This latest round of frigid temperatures will no doubt put a strain on our state's inadequate power grid, so be sure you and your family prepare accordingly.
Check out this winter weather preparedness guide and stay warm! [https://www.wunderground.com/prepare/winter-weather]
A new Texas House member takes the speaker's gavel
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dustin%20Burrows%20House%20Speaker.jpg]
Tuesday marked the start of our state's legislative session, with the 150 members of the Texas House of Representatives voting to select a new House speaker. Republican Dustin Burrows of Lubbock will now hold the role of Texas House Speaker, succeeding Dade Phelan [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/01/14/dustin-burrows-david-cook-texas-house-speaker-vote/] in what is shaping up to be a wild session filled with right-wing political grandstanding.
The role of House Speaker is critical in the legislative process. They choose committee chairmen and oversee the passage of bills and resolutions through the chamber. The speaker, together with the governor and lieutenant governor, is one of the "Big Three" state government leaders who have significant influence in crafting and passing legislation.
We'll see for ourselves in the coming weeks how this staunch conservative leads the Texas House and if he intends to wield his power fairly. For now, we're not holding our breath.
TOP Tip: Donate to mutual aid groups directly helping Southern California residents
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/California%20fires%20Jan.%202025.png]
Our hearts go out to all impacted by the massive wildfires that have devastated communities across Southern California, including those who are on the frontlines fighting the blazes. All of us have seen harrowing photos and video of the destruction from these fires, which so far have displaced tens of thousands of residents. To see entire neighborhoods consumed and reduced to rubble from these fires is a stark reminder of the growing threat of climate change. For all looking to pitch in funds and resources in relief efforts, we encourage you to visit the Mutual Aid Los Angeles Network (MALAN) website. [https://mutualaidla.org/]
You can donate directly to MALAN by clicking here. [https://hcb.hackclub.com/donations/start/malan]
Español
AGREGUE TU NOMBRE:
Defienda los derechos de los inquilinos en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20justice%202024.jpg]
La crisis de vivienda en Dallas sigue empeorando. Los precios de las rentas están subiendo más rápido que los salarios, los desalojos para algunos residentes se están llevando a cabo sin previo aviso ni causa, y la inestabilidad en la vivienda está en aumento.
Desde techos que se derrumban debido a daños por agua hasta cortes rutinarios del suministro de agua, innumerables inquilinos están viviendo con un mantenimiento deficiente y promesas rotas por parte de los propietarios, y muchos temen represalias si alzan la voz. A pesar de esto, las leyes actuales a nivel local y estatal ofrecen poca protección o apoyo para los inquilinos. ¡Estamos luchando por un cambio!
La organización de justicia de vivienda de TOP está arraigada en nuestra creencia fundamental de que la vivienda es un derecho humano y que todos en nuestras comunidades merecen un lugar seguro, accesible y estable para llamar hogar, sin importar nuestra edad, raza, género, fe o ingresos.
¡AGREGA TU NOMBRE si eres un residente de Dallas que está de acuerdo y que quiere sumarse a este trabajo de campaña vital! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc7xt9JezgWm3pil3PMcC1HyJVOTPmsxZdMxZkerJcMqS02WQ/viewform]
Para obtener más información, envía un correo electrónico a Iman a ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
Otra ráfaga de aire ártico está en camino
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Arctic%20blast%20Texas.png]
Otra ráfaga de aire ártico llegará a Texas al final de este fin de semana, mientras nuestro estado se prepara una vez más para temperaturas peligrosamente frías. El cambio climático es el responsable de estas ráfagas de frío más frecuentes en los Estados Unidos.
Obtenga más información sobre el desarrollo del clima aquí. [https://www.newsweek.com/dangerously-cold-arctic-air-january-forecast-map-2014553]
Esta última ronda de temperaturas invernales sin duda pondrá a prueba la inadecuada red eléctrica de nuestro estado, así que asegúrese de que usted y su familia estén preparados en consecuencia.
¡Consulte esta guía de preparación para el clima invernal y manténgase abrigado! [https://www.wunderground.com/prepare/winter-weather]
Un nuevo miembro de la Cámara estatal es elegido como Presidente de la Cámara de Representantes de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dustin%20Burrows%20House%20Speaker.jpg]
El martes marcó el inicio de la sesión legislativa de nuestro estado, con los 150 miembros de la Cámara de Representantes de Texas votando para seleccionar a un nuevo presidente de la Cámara. El republicano Dustin Burrows, de Lubbock, ocupará ahora el cargo de presidente de la Cámara de Representantes de Texas, sucediendo a Dade Phelan [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/01/14/dustin-burrows-david-cook-texas-house-speaker-vote/] , en lo que promete ser una sesión tumultuosa llena de exhibicionismo político de derecha.
El papel del presidente de la Cámara es fundamental en el proceso legislativo. Elige a los presidentes de los comités y supervisa la aprobación de proyectos de ley y resoluciones en la cámara. Junto con el gobernador y el vicegobernador, el presidente de la Cámara es uno de los "Tres Grandes" líderes del gobierno estatal que tienen una influencia significativa en la creación y aprobación de leyes.
Veremos en las próximas semanas cómo este conservador acérrimo lidera la Cámara de Texas y si planea ejercer su poder de manera justa. Por ahora, no estamos conteniendo la respiración.
Consejos de TOP: Done a grupos de ayuda mutua que ayudan directamente a los residentes del sur de California
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/California%20fires%20Jan.%202025.png]
Nuestro corazón está con todos los afectados por los enormes incendios forestales que han devastado comunidades en todo el sur de California, incluidos aquellos que están en primera línea combatiendo las llamas. Todos hemos visto fotos y videos desgarradores de la destrucción causada por estos incendios, que hasta ahora han desplazado a decenas de miles de residentes. Ver vecindarios enteros consumidos y reducidos a escombros por estos incendios es un duro recordatorio de la creciente amenaza del cambio climático. Para todos aquellos que buscan aportar fondos y recursos para los esfuerzos de socorro, los alentamos a visitar el sitio web de Mutual Aid Los Angeles Network (MALAN). [https://mutualaidla.org/]
Puede donar directamente a MALAN haciendo clic aquí. [https://hcb.hackclub.com/donations/start/malan]

Rent prices are rising faster than wages, evictions for some residents are happening without notice or cause, and housing instability is on the rise. Despite this, current laws at the local and state levels offer little protection or support for renters. We're pushing for change! TOP's housing justice organizing is rooted in our fundamental belief that housing is a human right, and that all in our communities deserve a safe, affordable, and stable place to call home — no matter our age, race, gender, faith, or income. name: Kirk Cameron
subject: You'll want this in your home in 2025
body:
Please -- for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0ntr4fq2fed7ta7cdtv2hhdgfb9ficjp5il5m30_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjs01ncnb51l93egef2s7oogtdln8m68l7qdl0dg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgo3853q0cl8p6pi1biubqk6icfo7smou18ftgc8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziu8mtkldrm9fg3gcmtk4ou4kg4nou7fvqaobgm0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z30c2s0ve1q98ur8qhvjm6ugea3pi72cqc1mj82g_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---

|

The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart -- maybe even yours -- is to support the very first children's television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[**Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z94hfek1435mvnclujg0ifvkrf2400uish1758q0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2c5h2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Brand-new kid's book "The 10 Commandments for Kids"
body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life.

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zn232g2307e68u81t0r4ifblvueihs37kkuj7s48_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2clh2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z54ll7amstlja16hdpopjb8g6t2ch8q96gti3rr0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2clh2bs)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zt625758nmdgrn8bcbvq4us2qoiktvlpji5lgmq8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h6aoj2clh2bs)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Your input is needed
body:
The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqh26r513c2m5rl217b8farejbdkmpv78usb4r50_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h61o72cph2bs)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5gofdrub5am1dj7g41pknis0r450fbtgdgg8pn0_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h61o72cph2bs).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z4ebnn0a63pn42vfp2dle79nu1inr3cgqf0nsbh8_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h61o72cph2bs)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zhh5cs0ja25lcnoggpb8o7eu4j1pt56f04uvammg_rp22sh2s8i6epj7c1h61o72cph2bs)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---
| | Hillsdale College 33 East College St Hillsdale, MI 49242 USA

---

Your America
---

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |
---
| | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b069acc71ee144ac8994af5b5d764586&_e=hTDNpSfVCEMxNxAJobegcNaPAv1GUWOU7oz2vSfYhT9Oxvz0MsMQczmalRU0yNLUPDBtXMPYsFpCMrs5CCNDZyi0df5gA70MlLJZg3lUaJY6gA3y6UFrKzwhesL0wEmdUZTYvjLqgmXumI-RtK28cYvNJip6MaZXOk-7NNsUe9e2yqyOm7b57dIaOPiDDXJWTbbICx3YPra3xUh5wt7G1vX2UmNSyiuzVs5qRRwBKeh2JNd3BqgdNIfnfeV0iAVHRWigOmBYA5gKaZc1MMLpiYyFicqi76W9dZv8-n3Ftr0u1iLcQtc-tir66URmif1MZFz11gNOKO3y7MVnPhJsVQUKMXsxVCIU4LUqECXXzwc41n2aOzXCwLhQdah78oc-Xhbev2WnRP0s826vCEK0Aaiz6K05734vnH-8cO-MsIk%3D)

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b069acc71ee144ac8994af5b5d764586&_e=hTDNpSfVCEMxNxAJobegcNaPAv1GUWOU7oz2vSfYhT9Oxvz0MsMQczmalRU0yNLUPDBtXMPYsFpCMrs5CCNDZyi0df5gA70MlLJZg3lUaJY6gA3y6UFrKzwhesL0wEmdUZTYvjLqgmXumI-RtK28cYvNJip6MaZXOk-7NNsUe9e2yqyOm7b57dIaOPiDDXJWTbbICx3YPra3xUh5wt7G1vX2UmNSyiuzVs5qRRwBKeh2JNd3BqgdNIfnfeV0iAVH3Xsz836JiO4V09sPyZzr3F89lDWngkpFhluVpnggmrjSm6fLY9JYuqcuv4jtTnk5k_MzBrR4AhO-lDPnPMyderohjT49zDsCf42nx7UZ_MJnHeiPeiaUYfB4DswCEoO5V7vnAW9x7PkYpgVb55KaIfnKBmzLQ8EAbsetDJcDa04%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b069acc71ee144ac8994af5b5d764586&_e=hTDNpSfVCEMxNxAJobegcNaPAv1GUWOU7oz2vSfYhT9Oxvz0MsMQczmalRU0yNLUPDBtXMPYsFpCMrs5CCNDZyi0df5gA70MlLJZg3lUaJY6gA3y6UFrKzwhesL0wEmdUZTYvjLqgmXumI-RtK28cYvNJip6MaZXOk-7NNsUe9e2yqyOm7b57dIaOPiDDXJWTbbICx3YPra3xUh5wt7G1vX2UmNSyiuzVs5qRRwBKeh2JNd3BqgdNIfnfeV0iAVHCGNXp5o6n5bZWRjHCpXB-SvukxSUtJKFWN70aR7MMutzv1lim_dbMpk8gDS4H1JakoTF8yilqg_ZSFQaARXT1cJvZtgc0SGsp-oNYTilPGSiR6CtTphq_46or1rZBnxCmB0IabUux2ajnP0GPHmZB4ctoRVoPR2kM1jX8nmVvLY%3D)**

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

subject: Your input is needed
body:
The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |

| | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=24b7a8b1bd5c493a8c535a940b9ac317&_e=DJf4rLhX93EER3AehNm6hUcKyqbPCr6fXAp33l_IxnENVNmz9NXhFDvtrBbzB04Xvi6p-wwvpCDb-ha10XbAfMtMtZVJrWhuCfmwRjonXM5EV5sQqIfhEbBA2T61uiLDRpmyIa_CuYaIbp3ym2iU86knGkTron1-P1mphivZt-Guy1Y209qvkK2Zcn35_fpq5Wrcl_rVnAEn9KaGRhq2YwlPfYucM54kZcHymw-qvZ-owBCaaPw12WfxUoH2wxQDv2beqx33ji_yku5kFXqwhxkJW3_Om-OJeKmNbVsyLyDx2z8I3lHsZQh76ZYhukAaj_Tjfd-khn3uIe1Se-z_RlFb1lzsO9sCfANxc7BK5-9iH3UQNMkgEmKGwjwn1ydkCF6ec84HmEr28pmuX7U7cmM49VJ31HHVFCk--k4cgdo%3D)

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=24b7a8b1bd5c493a8c535a940b9ac317&_e=DJf4rLhX93EER3AehNm6hUcKyqbPCr6fXAp33l_IxnENVNmz9NXhFDvtrBbzB04Xvi6p-wwvpCDb-ha10XbAfMtMtZVJrWhuCfmwRjonXM5EV5sQqIfhEbBA2T61uiLDRpmyIa_CuYaIbp3ym2iU86knGkTron1-P1mphivZt-Guy1Y209qvkK2Zcn35_fpq5Wrcl_rVnAEn9KaGRhq2YwlPfYucM54kZcHymw-qvZ-owBCaaPw12WfxUoH2wxQDpXnwYvp0dCfUX6xIWao6qz9HuvQBBUPDoT_1sVx34VzICBlTiEjppxnQp9rO1mJgKGMGLmpjcffs8RFpBP_nfImYt7MvhMOnfimhoMqnrCSoCh7NYjQz905Tghe1h703d6iLpP3_x6Ah1--V9uDch4meIFI6-SimqXRthtxv0Jw%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=24b7a8b1bd5c493a8c535a940b9ac317&_e=DJf4rLhX93EER3AehNm6hUcKyqbPCr6fXAp33l_IxnENVNmz9NXhFDvtrBbzB04Xvi6p-wwvpCDb-ha10XbAfMtMtZVJrWhuCfmwRjonXM5EV5sQqIfhEbBA2T61uiLDRpmyIa_CuYaIbp3ym2iU86knGkTron1-P1mphivZt-Guy1Y209qvkK2Zcn35_fpq5Wrcl_rVnAEn9KaGRhq2YwlPfYucM54kZcHymw-qvZ-owBCaaPw12WfxUoH2wxQDzPmXjJ_PZ27bNla01JaY96drTE9pIf_pNCCELt8cwHFMsTtSRp6sZ_GwPrrzm5BUwchvw4LtIvolFf-ygWIWVRMwggdAkDfjYINLeTSVEqXIXOwV4MkHCLctKYwLWs9jSRSNhsxNy-fF4YzZfg9YUgqq7DfWLRhsl3vway7MEvY%3D)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=24b7a8b1bd5c493a8c535a940b9ac317&_e=DJf4rLhX93EER3AehNm6hUcKyqbPCr6fXAp33l_IxnENVNmz9NXhFDvtrBbzB04Xvi6p-wwvpCDb-ha10XbAfMtMtZVJrWhuCfmwRjonXM5EV5sQqIfhEbBA2T61uiLDRpmyIa_CuYaIbp3ym2iU86knGkTron1-P1mphivZt-Guy1Y209qvkK2Zcn35_fpq5Wrcl_rVnAEn9KaGRhq2YwlPfYucM54kZcHymw-qvZ-owBCaaPw12WfxUoH2wxQDV_236kexcS9E9N7QkHLHZ7Bi3EzxuZimlytIcAaVqEqIG2S8b5uTCuoapX356MdFgDRzmGXilKOL18srsyWH5dX0KpqAtxdOjhT5vq8FwnEeqS4gvfBf4agaCaJ8GkarO6foDe5UEyJixMvvDbf384YYEgu-r1cu83oYua34CuA%3D)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.
---

body:
The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | |

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ksaHMAbulltWnBxPUhQZPQ~~/AARclAA~~~).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ksaHMAbulltWnBxPUhQZPQ~~/AARclAA~~~)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

**P.S.** I look forward to receiving your opinions about what's happening in our nation. And I hope that you can support our work.

So please complete the **National Referendum on the Administrative State** using this secure link:

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/ksaHMAbulltWnBxPUhQZPQ~~/AARclAA~~~)**

As soon as you respond, we will begin your FREE lifetime subscription to _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty that you will receive via email ten times a year. If you'd like, you can also sign up to receive the publication through postal mail.

Educating millions about the Constitution to counter the threat from the administrative state is a monumental task. That's why when you complete your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your commitment to liberty.

| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c9aac01a7b014673a4226744522cb306&_e=9y5Mdm-5TrBY95NOIJWZhu5A3ODNyB7wMOBqqWMqBaNDo1Et8f7wCpfPNr9lEsgowCq23QHYSo3tBtTpOtWSRV-BhhZNP46ewegEey5lUwtAt2kj_VSlgj_K2P2QTMzli1s3lVH1RmF4Efq7xjxSjr5dcfTjfvMAfh5HxMEtHw0wAaJeNXEuzpzLRVudNbetZ5q-EJO_HIL7eWAasBuhAR4B7nBCDpn2so6spnEfT8N-e56fmGx693Z4hGGGIAYfGeOq359GqYpF6q708w_s5REfsPIO4flhA031_LRTNUYITb6T-QjvEkBR25-psS9_iUVDiIWpd--deIc7A5caxxAYyLB65KAsoSqNMAgLSyNrIbN1DlTBPc5-p4Lp4OyYD4fxKV-OzP182FXeQPGhp4BGyOQnO74J8OngQ6rZ0S0%3D).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c9aac01a7b014673a4226744522cb306&_e=9y5Mdm-5TrBY95NOIJWZhu5A3ODNyB7wMOBqqWMqBaNDo1Et8f7wCpfPNr9lEsgowCq23QHYSo3tBtTpOtWSRV-BhhZNP46ewegEey5lUwtAt2kj_VSlgj_K2P2QTMzli1s3lVH1RmF4Efq7xjxSjr5dcfTjfvMAfh5HxMEtHw0wAaJeNXEuzpzLRVudNbetZ5q-EJO_HIL7eWAasBuhAR4B7nBCDpn2so6spnEfT8N-e56fmGx693Z4hGGGIAYfHE6mHcqIJw8Q_Kznb-ZNEMcYeaOeStcDSXB3bSE9ZYF8nkE8-rjnbYDG2__yl95uVUHDJmqcacykRkVtmpe9twW5s3GWtmVChhWOEuzB0fnx38hk-lmx3eBICtskaatGnf39QfG2eMigx7WUX2rkHVct8PdFHRZWTgR8izUGROY%3D)**

When you send in your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The rise of the administrative state is a grave threat to our country.

To counter this threat, Hillsdale sponsors several educational outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, programs on our Washington, D.C., campus, and a growing network of classical K-12 schools and homeschoolers--to teach citizens about the meaning of the Constitution and the importance of our founding principles of liberty.

Your gift of at least $15--or even $25, $35, $50, $100, or more if you're especially motivated to TAKE ACTION--will help us to expand these educational initiatives that are reaching and teaching millions.

Your support of these efforts is essential because Hillsdale refuses to take ONE PENNY of government funding.

So please complete your **National Referendum on the Administrative State** and consider giving your most generous tax-deductible contribution.

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
