body:
Please -- for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba861a75b3804d1f88233f57760587ab&_e=zFnjd0b7_qJ_ePg6SsLr77oeWfxwGpTbBlnTGZTcPk7dL7L1u7pjNzIlI6kegxzklnN-qYxou0Hth6fmj_8KjytJqfT1TC00OgkhkhRW2SGMrhrtaKKfwR7LOFS2hlLmIszDnkZqGkz7CTxRJM772_bYrovsEusObsK_FNoPrOor_6t-Q4urSXlEfl5EFdMoztfH_Mxd9HPpMefa0Jtvx7XlOiyREnz5Lwmczp2GAfDNOBtZFCnQvYQMIFPWbWHZTQ3HUk8zSmOBUueghrtijyXDoyYxQp09DSa5B7tPq7znQIrRDdImiLGT17m33zBA_jZ4fHxdtRPw8674Y5EPPLog0eMgxvgYDLRXQO2LYLmTrGQIi_UWobJkAaRyjaHq7xpsDRb5tkOqlyClNK95yg%3D%3D)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba861a75b3804d1f88233f57760587ab&_e=zFnjd0b7_qJ_ePg6SsLr77oeWfxwGpTbBlnTGZTcPk7dL7L1u7pjNzIlI6kegxzklnN-qYxou0Hth6fmj_8KjytJqfT1TC00OgkhkhRW2SGMrhrtaKKfwR7LOFS2hlLmIszDnkZqGkz7CTxRJM772_bYrovsEusObsK_FNoPrOor_6t-Q4urSXlEfl5EFdMoztfH_Mxd9HPpMefa0Jtvx7XlOiyREnz5Lwmczp2GAfDNOBtZFCnQvYQMIFPWbWHZDWDsTf_h7jONCwFem8M4Rqpd1y-w5wusZeaJlACslMc_r8OZhP2WAiXZKJ7QTgje-WPNNTU0DKuiKwFTvp3juN-Bl0EY85av6aw3tC0mfMP_BFTZz5d55V1Y_R058TXxM1gPMBv63uvfLSjKdoGCMg%3D%3D)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba861a75b3804d1f88233f57760587ab&_e=zFnjd0b7_qJ_ePg6SsLr77oeWfxwGpTbBlnTGZTcPk7dL7L1u7pjNzIlI6kegxzklnN-qYxou0Hth6fmj_8KjytJqfT1TC00OgkhkhRW2SGMrhrtaKKfwR7LOFS2hlLmIszDnkZqGkz7CTxRJM772_bYrovsEusObsK_FNoPrOor_6t-Q4urSXlEfl5EFdMoztfH_Mxd9HPpMefa0Jtvx7XlOiyREnz5Lwmczp2GAfDNOBtZFCnQvYQMIFPWbWHZ8GtUBChB4uwCUEW_FLZU5Ih3qz-P3kZurYw7yAV9qD6Zupk-oi3yLce8haeeKF68a7xR0wfo7aC2K712wNJp6sY3yC_kyU4-QZX6GLaXgtCXm0Y8BjV1HMZHIxBEqwsmfRHUrQpMeNjwRC6cCYn95g%3D%3D) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba861a75b3804d1f88233f57760587ab&_e=zFnjd0b7_qJ_ePg6SsLr77oeWfxwGpTbBlnTGZTcPk7dL7L1u7pjNzIlI6kegxzklnN-qYxou0Hth6fmj_8KjytJqfT1TC00OgkhkhRW2SGMrhrtaKKfwR7LOFS2hlLmIszDnkZqGkz7CTxRJM772_bYrovsEusObsK_FNoPrOor_6t-Q4urSXlEfl5EFdMoztfH_Mxd9HPpMefa0Jtvx7XlOiyREnz5Lwmczp2GAfDNOBtZFCnQvYQMIFPWbWHZKbAqZ49vPrOPnQYRoDw1KymK9WUKI7CkahxeX55r4f2GVkPHOb4cysCmaXLl7IKWgvhAG7pDwphelzGSkJi6gKGrm0e2JqsD18m6Vm6Yv1v96b1ruyGTiFEuJWa4A_yCpabMfAujuOkYXbVMfouFaQ%3D%3D)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ba861a75b3804d1f88233f57760587ab&_e=zFnjd0b7_qJ_ePg6SsLr77oeWfxwGpTbBlnTGZTcPk7dL7L1u7pjNzIlI6kegxzklnN-qYxou0Hth6fmj_8KjytJqfT1TC00OgkhkhRW2SGMrhrtaKKfwR7LOFS2hlLmIszDnkZqGkz7CTxRJM772_bYrovsEusObsK_FNoPrOor_6t-Q4urSXlEfl5EFdMoztfH_Mxd9HPpMefa0Jtvx7XlOiyREnz5Lwmczp2GAfDNOBtZFCnQvYQMIFPWbWHZtEZeBs30B5z6HxppcBWapp0mgtgFyo-ZziZdCWjuJAgn5spj76PTYZD4X2cjLMprTIb6mD769TWLBiSqbGMFAfFAR8RoKH3IT1IsC2jlzjQ0g6SOOQPat0YqqWc1NtuomCEOne56jceRnerj2Zv0zA%3D%3D)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

## Brazoria County Deputy Killed in Line of Duty
Deputy Jesus Vargas of the Brazoria County Sheriff's Office was shot and killed while serving a warrant in southwest Houston yesterday. The suspect, Sean Christopher Davis, was [killed hours later](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAQRp8Gd1gw_NkFxW3c5bZbWmMYYhQcIpuNk7dfZfstP33S0dH5uswXzCXfr_9xI99eqc4gwHAhubRzxFzes-6iX0QcZUdeOuUEODGqbvXaOmEAMJjRaLEMWsEy2KSQcDAgbJf9ByaktFIqqVQPSMaMywIuGjEOlmlBMbe6922lRi88UnnXJ-19qFtX_Nra42DqH4OJwXSeZ39b6_fnZDDh3nIoxGC603kwmMKet888GpWCvOT7jdeUcqCdH2ttDCYYDCeD6PSQeIyCuAZFfDFy5NFGaVQMSQXV7T4-zlxKPqxjWlw3zOVXqv1Z6enhJwAA___uf2Zm) in a shootout with police near the crime scene. Wanted for aggravated sexual assault, Davis, 56, allegedly shot Vargas during a traffic stop and fled the scene. After an hours-long manhunt, Davis was [found in a dumpster](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2O6yAQxfGngY6IGQzEBcVt3OW2W1rYDDFabCJg8_H2q6Tf-kjnJ_2_LvPFp5yO63-_k-vPWGaUqIUEAWYOPuXXPPDgFhlG4OTAKivRylHxzRmpKQwGgsU1hggGI0Y9KFBhXKxBntz7TAIYAAVKndCT1uOyoA1ajmfDBkkh9VJPfaNOT99ifpU71dNadp7d1vutMfWP4cRw8ssK6r0wnLJ_CDpiqSvtdHRRYkwrVdG20kXrlLMXOR3fohYfxFZ-Wi-H-BAMJ9BnicZYhhOvLtweKefUjGWDvO4-5Q_f_-xxd_gbAAD__264Yb0) at the site of the shooting by a K-9 working with the U.S. Marshals. Davis opened fire from inside the dumpster, [striking the dog at least twice](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAYhJ8Gd1jwY3BcUFxDl2uvtDD82OgIWIbEyduvvNp2u9Fo9M1o_t3nu40p5vWvfaBu71BmYCAp45Sr2duYPvPQeb0wP_EONR_FyGBkk-g2zYJnE6JbRmUVymFCGQaAmwcFA5eii_qCMc4V54IL0YNFKadlgdFLNt0UGRj62MrRtw0bvm0N6VNeePSuPLqkt9b2SsQfAoaAOc-zdym6_7CVZ20lXykCJuNZCZhUnE0EzNVJwDBOwPBLlRCiw4PWrTRqG60n_QFc1r7HvFKHueFBw3ONLb6QlkzbhvR4ZgKmO7Tfz5hSrGokA1sfNqbvie3Xz14avgIAAP___TxuOw), prompting deputies to return fire and kill him. The dog was rushed to an area vet via helicopter and is reportedly in stable condition. Vargas was a 17-year veteran of the sheriff’s office and leaves behind a wife and three children. _"He was more than a team member—he was a friend, mentor, and inspiration to everyone who knew him. His professionalism and kind nature left a lasting impact on our office and the residents he served,”_ said the Brazoria County Sheriff’s Office [in a statement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LGOszAQBOCnMZ2RvQaDCxd_Q5e_vRIZvA6rc9gI-0Ly9qecrr3202g0mo_LfAmUab_-Dzf09Zl4BgW9VFpqO8dA-TV3TfSLik436PVgBgWDcqbZvLGrMylgNwaEMXWuQwhjr4OLsCzQN-TfZUprq7XRxrQQsO_dssAQe-VGKzqFkSofbd2w4jOUlF_8wKNd-dZkv9V6L8L8EzAJmM7zbBM_wW78VSrv75CAacezCJh-Ud4504qybMyV9qvklGjF4w1Vloo5B5lp_5QHhyitVs3h4_2knKnYQXTqeguUfwbUPx95ePgOAAD__0WuZOs).
## Study on Massive Reservoir Submitted to Abbott
The Texas Water Development Board submitted a report to Gov. Greg Abbott earlier this month, deeming the proposed Marvin Nichols Reservoir in northeast Texas feasible and suggesting it [could be completed by 2050](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD3L4zAQhH-N3K2R5K-4UJEr3L2pDq4062gdL-gjSIqd_PvD6d9qBgYeHubfz_yD7Dg8bujJlPcaZy11B1KB6meL7D5zW1mzSDuqiowamkHqQY5NtRkaL-2lW7tFrv2Ko6S7RWV137Zo-7GTFZsTJpXqlWpU09QaqevGZdGD7eR46UUryXKJqS4bFXpjXt0n7pTqe_SVM1spzyyaq9CT0NNxHLXP4dyEnijAKws9BTrO-PYvAg4slGCJmCxYIp_BY9o5QOD7Fl2GRJnSHjnBSph5cQQcINEzpgL5tXguhSyUCI9TJsQk9IQJrlf1ptufv1Uy9nmwc5z7QbTy4ZHdV7n8-uFu9P8AAAD___HudtM). The 66,000-acre reservoir has long been proposed as a [source of water for Region C](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2OwyAQBOCnwR3Wsvi3oLjGXa690sJmiVeHTQTITt7-lPTXj74Zzc9tvlkOfNy_7U6mPH2cEbCVoKTqZmc5vOamcmYBN6qKjOp1D9jDqKvN6LXphsGPMBB43zbUeVhGGpwG1Kt2FZs3Bkp1SmmldY2W2nZcFuxdC-PQiQbIcYmpLhsVetrswyuelOo17lUwWymPLPSXwEngdF1X_ZtzSdZxfCcETu8CgRMogdMHkJctlKSjk0J87HQUuUSbnHREe5a7TScf8uB1iyHLRJnSGTlJTzbzEkjgVCXjHheHwLnrRQP33XL4LCr_XnQa_AsAAP__iVhqEA), which includes the fast-growing Dallas-Fort Worth area. However, it has faced decades of opposition from residents and officials in Region D, where the reservoir would be built. The project’s estimated cost has ballooned to more than $7 billion in recent years. It would require extensive state and federal permitting processes that could take 15 to 20 years. Public comments on the feasibility review, mostly from residents in northeast Texas, [overwhelmingly opposed the reservoir](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD2PpiAURn8Ndhg-RLSg2MZutt3SXOAy3gTFAHHm_febfbee-slzcnL-fOwfQJmuz99wouvfqexKKMOF5HLeI1B-7dMQnRdxlQM6abUVyopVD4fzi4EZhTG4pknPwSeMy2TRCJ-WAHEg9w8mpJyl1FLrUQEas3qvbDRiXWY2CYzUSx37gR2_oaX8Kg_WMZRzyO7o_W5M_2JqY2rrr4z1hvv_zNR24VdjasslQGZqO6E-dPGLwlFy4xUb1qdQ5RHxxMgTQiOfkUdsN3Xk7yMv910adSoXUxvUTiHjbiBqlB54CIvkUmLiEGDhc0rRBgtWmWU8-pmH6uL9RTlTmy2bxOcJlN_6_ceej1N_AwAA__9OsHpY). Key concerns cited were the potential displacement of generational landowners and the use of eminent domain. A decision on the reservoir won’t happen anytime soon. Each of the state’s sixteen regional planning groups will submit a proposal to state planners by March 3. Revised plans incorporating public comments and the water board’s feedback will be submitted by Oct. 20.
## Dallas "De-extinction" Startup Valued at $10 Billion
Colossal Biosciences, a Dallas-based genetic engineering startup founded in 2021, has [reached a $10 billion valuation](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGurCAURb8GOwwcUMaCYhq7ee0rDcLROQnCRJhR__5mbn-rXexkZWX9f0wPR5HS-s9taOu55AkEdFxILvspOIrXpJtgZxEG2aCVRhkBRgyqedoeg0Yhb7OBQSstZS-E0ui00p0B4xqyX5iQspdSSaVacNh1wzyDCZ0Ybj3TAgPVvLf1iRVPV5Z45Q_urc9bE-2z1ldh6s5gZDAex9FuJX0_BiMm_i4Mxi0nvBiMKybcXWQw-hxzKS7ymXLxhMlj4cXnHQtPePDlnQKllX9cfH83IMezUvKVcuI-by-XLu4ql2JmMLqd3-_yXEj1zW7D66AYqfSGabFujuKva_0z3sfCTwAAAP__Lb9yQg) after receiving $435 million in funding from financier Mark Walter, adventurer Victor Vescovo, and _Lord of the Rings_ director Peter Jackson. The company focuses on "de-extinction" projects, aiming to [resurrect species](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuO8yAQBeCnwd1EzBBfKCj-xl3-dktruCRGCyYy5Pb2K2-_3ZGO9OnofF2WC8cUt9t_zsG097UsJKkHiYDD4jmmz3LuvLHSa-yCwVGNkkapVbcaJDc61OSVVjQFN_WTRadZoyJFFrtoDkwiDogKlToRh77X1tLoe6mnQZxl8LGV_dTW0MKb6zV9yjPsJ1dyl8za2r0K9U_QLGhuwa1uf2xuPWpB86ELmiUKmvFIrqRSKyewsVQXw-ZChZ1jDRVIygzcACWQhSenB7dYNmgF7B63G1h23_AqJaUPZM65tLUKmrvd-PsrphTrMIqzvGWO6Xdf-_Owp6GfAAAA__-tu2vm) such as the woolly mammoth, dodo bird, and Tasmanian tiger through advanced genetic editing. With 170 scientists and partners on staff across three labs in Dallas, Boston, and Melbourne, Colossal has developed genomes for each of these species and hatched “chimeric chicks” to serve as [surrogates for dodos](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LluwzAQBNCvkbo1eOiwChZp3DltSoHHSlqAIg0uLdt_H9hFurSDwcNgfq7z1VKktH7bHU19LnlWQvUgJMhhDpbia-7aYJwIk2zRyFGPQo1i0u1m1HkQyo1usELL0QXhz1L2odNuWXoxdS2ZNyakHKTUUuuTstj3k3NqDL2YzkPTCQxUcznVDSs-LS_xlQ8sJ5_3Npqt1hs3-qtRl0Zdgo3RMqWUD1uR352_FHyOmdlGcJTZEyaPDA593pHhQ8NChSsE9NbnkoDR3wulFaQA5eCw8W4r5QQPqhswFkIGD8s9BUproy5tMeH2oBiJh7HpxLpbip-l9d_rDqN-AwAA___Ps3QC). “ _The technological advances we’re seeing in genetic engineering and synthetic biology are rapidly transforming our understanding of what’s possible in species restoration_ ,” Chief Science Officer Beth Shapiro said.

Study on Massive Reservoir Submitted to Abbott The Texas Water Development Board submitted a report to Gov. Greg Abbott earlier this month, deeming the proposed Marvin Nichols Reservoir in northeast Texas feasible and suggesting it . The 66,000-acre reservoir has long been proposed as a , which includes the fast-growing Dallas-Fort Worth area. However, it has faced decades of opposition from residents and officials in Region D, where the reservoir would be built. The project’s estimated cost has ballooned to more than $7 billion in recent years. It would require extensive state and federal permitting processes that could take 15 to 20 years. Public comments on the feasibility review, mostly from residents in northeast Texas, . Key concerns cited were the potential displacement of generational landowners and the use of eminent domain. A decision on the reservoir won’t happen anytime soon. Each of the state’s sixteen regional planning groups will submit a proposal to state planners by March 3. Revised plans incorporating public comments and the water board’s feedback will be submitted by Oct. 20. ## Biden Delivers Farewell Address
President Joe Biden [delivered his farewell address](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuxCAQRL8Gd7bYBUNcUKRxd2lTWmCWu42wfcLo0P195PTpRprRPL3v23LznHm_f_mNXE3HghLHXkIPZome83vRXXSJCEl15MAqK9GqyXYPp9WqVNAjGJkmRfYj-BG0nhAorCNMHbvrTQIYAGXQDKBBRqIUpTIUJAotKXI9yvBz8F4flPL7eFEZ1mPrsnvU-jyF-hQ4C5xba8Mazp3aefUC5ysKnANH2vtn4Y0qb9QnX6hRzr2PsdB5Tbri4rNxznwaK7S8b57zH6X-Z_1y-BsAAP__okdZmw) to the nation on Wednesday night, reflecting on his decades-long political career and achievements. He also cautioned against what he described as a "rising oligarchy." The 17-minute speech started with praise for his foreign policy team on securing a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas. He then warned about the "[dangerous concentration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQhX-NvWHBQXAyMHTJlq4dLcKd46sIWIBC8-8rd-_0nvSk90nf1225eY6cHp_-Sa6teQEJJyGVUHZBz_G9mBHdSgSkR3Jq1rOEWV_mcXM2nKQPhOaMGoPHk7_IANbAZb6HcDYju-NNKmWV0hbspIySSLSi1JbuEgYjCbnlMn1nTm2jNb7zi8oU8nOMbmttr4P-GOA6wLX3Pq35J1Gvxz7Adc-RG4d61EKVkVIT9yNEpSaQIr-oiNUX6hSjqDtR2ETyjXMai8O9c4xc7TwY-Xh6jn_g9p-Il4PfAAAA__8a7mK4) of power among a few ultra-wealthy individuals." Describing it as an oligarchy and [a tech-industrial complex](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOwyAQBb_G7ohgwdguKK5Jl2uvtPDukmxETIRRovz9yddf-fSk0Wh-LsslSpbt-h0fHFoqC2gYlDbK-IWi5M_iegqJGdj2HMxoRw2jncf-FuboJosIdo5DtDoxwIppwHlCmL2begkHTRvjjbEe_Mk4o4k5kbaeVw2d00zSSj3di2ztxil_yovrCcujz-HW2nPv7FcH5w7O8bnxez-uY9QmmLmD872wWoV4UylWfnPOKhJV3ndVXjGrkpIgq2lFrweDoCOhWREMING0Mgzj5MH1NdDzLTnL7sfO6esjSv7zaP91eQX4DQAA__97ymO7), Biden stated that this new power posed a threat to the nation's democracy and fundamental rights and freedoms, referencing President Dwight Eisenhower's warnings about the military-industrial complex when he left office. Biden then [called for reforms](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DGP8yAMxvFPQzYq20ngzcDwLtl6640RKaZ1RUMEtFW__Sm33_aXLP1kPd_n5ewlyXb98g92LeaFgEYNqNEswUv6LEMXXGQm7jt2aHsLZPvJdjeH6wrT2EdjxwnYryYS_xsNIOE6mdF24g4NEA1ib8iccEAIzDFAb3gFUgNwkJbL6Z5lazeO6ZNfXE6X_OiSu7W2V9X_VzQrmrfPnms7TormA1Y0Ayqa8ahn1Ru_q6L5nlmvEnirei9cj2rik46-8JtT0j6EwrXqJC_Wzz34xlUX9pcmeTuErriwvyUlqcaqAa4PL-n3p_bXRi9HPwEAAP__eVRoTw) to the tax code, term limits for Supreme Court justices, and a constitutional amendment to end presidential immunity, concluding that it has been a privilege to serve the nation for over 50 years.
## Israel, Hamas Agree on Ceasefire
Israel and Hamas on Wednesday [reached a tentative ceasefire](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFuhDAQBNCvMZ3Reg3mUrhIQ3dpU6IFL7CRwchYh-7vI9KnG2mkp9F8P4cnSZR9-aKNfZnTgICtBqONGwJJfA9NFfzMjGwr9qazHWBnP7pq9WFkSzyPITChbQEBXMvYPtoHNq4xlfhbA2OcMdahq01jIDDPAazjEVA1wEFKyvVPkr2sPMd3enGup7RV0a-lHKeynwp7hf11XfW0j9NdKuxvWmEPRmFv7iRnJo56pY1OPTGdPEtmvaaz0MI6MEVNS2YOuiQtuz6y7JMckeu1bLHKPhyXxCin61QDy0YS_4aU_455efwNAAD__2J7ZIk) agreement and hostage release deal, pausing the 15-month war in the Gaza Strip. The negotiated ceasefire will be implemented in three phases over six weeks, starting on Sunday. Phase one calls for the release of 33 of the nearly 100 hostages still held by Hamas and a drawdown of Israeli troops in Gaza. Negotiations for phase two [will start on Day 16](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO2zAQRL-G6tYglzwqKlgECNRd2pTCWlyZG1CUQhI2nK8P7NTXTDEDDB7er8_lkyRLuf2knUPfjgU1foA2YPwSSfJzcUMMGzOyHTiY0Y4aRzuNQwqe8ANXpGmMWkc06zdvxrjqyTl3dVMcJLzetDHeGOvRX4wzOjJvUVvPV43KaY7Sj3r5fUjpibf8PO5cL-uxDzmk3s-m7HeFs8K5J06S82tTOKdj58KPpnCm8x0gpXMt1OUolP9Xu8SYGZhah0ydW4c_1KlCo2cDaZU4A5UIiXZqUJnWxBEIVqbGm1QGKXCjv_RisHO_Vt6U_ZHOoYZ4PiRnaX5UTt92kjfb0L_yeA_4LwAA___JGHaR) of the ceasefire, aiming for the release of all living hostages and the complete withdrawal of Israeli forces. Phase three will involve returning the bodies of remaining hostages and beginning reconstruction in Gaza. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu [hasn't formally accepted](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO8yAQBOCngY5oWQj8FBR_4y7XXmmtzRJzwrFluER5-5Ovv2k_aTSaz9t4o1LL4_5BK8eetxEBrwq00m5MVOp7tDLFzIxsJEftjQf0Jni5RJ5NNp54BgQH2digryHRv2v2GtgGWeLZBlo7rY1Dd9FWQ2LOCYzjCVBY4FT6dly-tvLoC-f63p58XOZtlTUuve9NmP8CB4ED7Q9-tZMEDrU8WeBQ2kFc1UIrNTUzNc7lYPW9J-rcBBo4o4NVbsqgEgRSlLJVPGXgyYaT5RHT_iq1lua8sHBfqdTfCf2vS54RfwIAAP__yVhgVQ) the ceasefire agreement, stating he would only issue a formal response "_after the final details of the agreement, which are currently being worked on, are completed_."
## TikTok to Shut Down in the U.S. on Sunday
TikTok plans to completely [shut down its app for U.S.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAYhJ8Gd1j8QLBcUOQUuTnlmiu2tIj5idlgsADH67dfefutRqPRjEbfx328Gx98fP4zC-rq0sgZv1AGFNRojQ_HKBurHSJH0aCGTnSMd6Lvmlm7h7qIh5kcs9DbqZdWSQDkSgoJ6tI3Xp9rDEABCMVVCxKYRXSWCYUPxolkaH1Nuf1MPtYZXTjSG3M7paUJeq51LURcCR8IH_Z9b5cSz4zwASPdCuFDxP2UitMcU0jP4zT-VdOLrhlXk7FQlzLdCi3zVm3aI3U5LbRs0ZqDlrTlCQst5myaTK9X-HK3_i8RQ5q8JeL25-SDe_mPeW2ytuvuQ_BFdUSy52J8-Llbf8P31vw7AAD__-EMc7U) users starting this Sunday when a federal ban could take effect unless blocked by the Supreme Court. Meanwhile, American users are flocking to Chinese social media platform Xiaohongshu (dubbed "RedNote"), making the Chinese-language app [the most downloaded on the Apple App Store](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDHPpCAQQH8NdhhARSkorrHba680I4zr3CIYmazZf3_Z67_6JS8v789jeQAlys_fcKDnrSxGmUEqLbVdIlD6LH0T_YZosGvQ67EblRk7Nza7d5MbhhgmpaLbYjBrGDqtrLObndTmXEP-a1NaW607a2yre60i4hZVZ3FVRvQKI3G52r-FMu-4pU9549WGcjTJ78xnFd0vYWZh5vu-27yGjHf9cmFmxrALM9cSCJI8MBIIM18Yc2GUYaeMFSXTi8tLQmK8MjC9UXI5q4TzlGGHi6uEHSHKFbK8QgY9jb0bm8vH86aUqNpR9Op5AKX_YfzTqLc3_wIAAP__IgJsGg) this week despite having no English interface. President Joe Biden signed legislation in April requiring ByteDance to sell its U.S. assets by January 19, 2025, or face a nationwide ban, although President-elect Donald Trump has called for extending the deadline. According to three sources familiar with the matter, the Biden administration is now reportedly exploring options to [keep TikTok accessible](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOwyAQBb8Gd1js4kBcUFzjLtdeaWFYJ5tgsGwuVv7-lPRXveJJo9H8XMaL58T5-u0XcnUuIyo8SQUSzBg9p9fYNdHNREi6IQdWW4VW97a5OR3PsbcQrA2nDsDYTk1qnkxvAM-qDw27N00BGABt0LTQgYpEc1Ta0KRQdIoi17K198K53mhOr_KkrQ1laZK71bruQn8JHAQOx3G0eQqZjv39CxzWkrhy2AUO90Jy4khZ4PBZ6ePCmfe6-colywfRKis_anlI__Sc_JRI_u5yC9nD2fYKm83F9eCUeDdWdOq6eE4flfpfmqfDvwAAAP__xdhmlQ) in the United States if a ban moves forward.

# [A giant wave of molasses once flooded the streets of Boston.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq6kfm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq6kfm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq6kfm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| O n January 15, 1919, more than [2 million gallons of molasses](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq6kfm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) spewed through Boston’s North End in an event known today as the Great Molasses Flood. The incident occurred due to a faulty storage tank managed by United States Industrial Alcohol, a distilling company. The massive storage vat measured 50 feet high with a diameter of 90 feet, and was known to rumble and leak from the time it was built in 1915. These issues occurred in part because the walls were only 0.31 to 0.67 inches thick, far too thin to contain the weight of a full tank of molasses.
---
On January 12 and 13, 600,000 gallons of molasses were pumped into the tank, filling it to capacity. This, coupled with temperature fluctuations that affected both the molasses and the vat itself, put an added strain on the tank. Two days later, the container burst from the pressure, sending a 40-foot-high wave of molasses gushing through the streets at a speed of up to 35 miles per hour. The destructive force of gooey liquid destroyed buildings and claimed 21 lives, requiring 87,000 worker hours to clean up in the event’s aftermath. For years after, residents claimed the area reeked of molasses on warmer days.

## A “Sacred Cod” hangs in the Massachusetts State House.
While cod is known to many as a delicious food, the fish holds a more hallowed meaning within the Massachusetts State House. An unusual wooden effigy known as the “[Sacred Cod](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sq6kfm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)” hangs from the building’s ceiling, a tradition that originated back in the 18th century. According to local legend, the inaugural cod was installed in the Old State House before the building was destroyed by a fire in 1747. A replacement fish was later stolen, and in 1784, a third cod was unveiled that still exists today. The nearly 6-foot-long wooden fish serves as a memorial to the importance of the state’s cod fishing industry. The current Sacred Cod was briefly fishnapped as a prank by students at Harvard University in 1933; upon its return, the fish was hung 6 feet higher for added security.

clean_body: On January 15, 1919, more than 2 million gallons of molasses spewed through Boston’s North End in an event known today as the Great Molasses Flood. | O n January 15, 1919, more than spewed through Boston’s North End in an event known today as the Great Molasses Flood. The incident occurred due to a faulty storage tank managed by United States Industrial Alcohol, a distilling company. The massive storage vat measured 50 feet high with a diameter of 90 feet, and was known to rumble and leak from the time it was built in 1915. These issues occurred in part because the walls were only 0.31 to 0.67 inches thick, far too thin to contain the weight of a full tank of molasses. On January 12 and 13, 600,000 gallons of molasses were pumped into the tank, filling it to capacity. This, coupled with temperature fluctuations that affected both the molasses and the vat itself, put an added strain on the tank. Two days later, the container burst from the pressure, sending a 40-foot-high wave of molasses gushing through the streets at a speed of up to 35 miles per hour. The destructive force of gooey liquid destroyed buildings and claimed 21 lives, requiring 87,000 worker hours to clean up in the event’s aftermath. While cod is known to many as a delicious food, the fish holds a more hallowed meaning within the Massachusetts State House. An unusual wooden effigy known as the “” hangs from the building’s ceiling, a tradition that originated back in the 18th century. According to local legend, the inaugural cod was installed in the Old State House before the building was destroyed by a fire in 1747. A replacement fish was later stolen, and in 1784, a third cod was unveiled that still exists today. The nearly 6-foot-long wooden fish serves as a memorial to the importance of the state’s cod fishing industry. The current Sacred Cod was briefly fishnapped as a prank by students at Harvard University in 1933; upon its return, the fish was hung 6 feet higher for added security. ¡Ay, Dios mio!

You won't believe this!

_**Official news just broke that Democrats are recruiting an _elitist celebrity_ to challenge me for the most important House seat in America.**_

My name is Monica De La Cruz. I'm the proud America First Hispanic conservative who humiliated Biden and the Democrats by flipping a solid blue seat in South Texas for the first time in 100 years.

By winning this race in 2024, we proved to the Left that Hispanic Americans no longer buy into their racist narrative that people who look and sound like us have to be Democrats.

We recognized that what they've done to this country is unforgivable, and we rejected them wholeheartedly by electing America First Republicans up and down the ballot.

But Democrats know how slim our GOP House majority is, and they know that my seat is the lynchpin that's keeping Republicans in charge in Washington.

body:
The trial of my life begins this week. And I don’t get a jury!
| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=9a67ee82192140579deb24aeb17fb249&_e=73WXAbzUsiqOUdc0oNs_96Txp7YVxWBvs_tnRX2sIeRm-HQ1FxBSrlrzWSlRwBvnmvMI_LeRAqKOr12z4r0PCBcqv8pSDZq7QWJ9yiyf3wYmvsjE38GAfrh7BkFKpXeLagCtwtpunotnXWUe9l_W0QGJNGJU3xe22CRyEwFavCeFs3QYQ6qUKIA_0HC8pVgy1Rgzria35BIuWxX9561hehHykURXNqZN5vrb8p5fNd0EiSL72wcWLmasF7M8OV99qH2T-2z7Hp6jBte77jmmuTxsu9wN55jSHHn0V_2ShwTzV9tiraI1axPIkaRYS8PsHeAMjECGs_DqPeIPjyW12a9-bHh_RT9M7coNfOPgpJE4RwH1qMRDsSDmeUPB4Wot)
---
Fellow Patriot,
---
With the trial of my life set to begin, President Donald J. Trump just said two powerful words for the entire nation to hear...
---
**_“SAVE RUDY!”_**
---
On Thursday, I will be on trial – __without_ a jury, mind you_ – to determine whether or not I still have a home to live in. It’s a trial to save my home and a trial to fight for my basic freedoms and rights.
---
_But more than that, our nation’s very system of justice will also be on trial._
---
If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America.
---
**Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud.**
---
I had a choice to make: _I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true._
---
When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "_For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)
---
You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and __our__ Republic.
---

If the Radical Left Democrats can get away with destroying me in a weaponized court without a jury – and possibly imprisoning me – solely because I served as President Trump’s lawyer, then the rule of law is DEAD in America. Just last week, a bloodthirsty left-wing judge threatened me with contempt and imprisonment if I didn’t recite her dictated false version of covered-up massive evidence of voter fraud. I had a choice to make: I could recite the state-sanctioned propaganda like an obedient little dog and be rewarded with a pat on the head. Or, I could have the courage to stand for what I know to be true. When I remind you of this Bible verse, you’ll know exactly which choice I made: "For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? " (Mark 8:36) You see, I refuse to give up on America. That’s why I’m going on trial to fight to save my home, my liberty, and our Republic. Are YOU with me? body:
Two critical picks for President Trump’s team need your voice now.
| | | |
---

| **** Another day brings more Senate hearings for President Trump's key appointments, and your voice matters now more than ever. Two of the most urgent confirmations are **Pete Hegseth** for Secretary of Defense and **Russell Vought** for Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB). The main point is that we must all be contacting our senators in support of President Trump's Cabinet nominees.
**Pete Hegseth
** Pete Hegseth's hearing has wrapped up, and the Senate is likely to vote on his nomination on Monday (or soon after). The left vehemently opposes him, so we need to rally behind Mr. Hegseth. A strong national defense starts with strong leadership, and Hegseth has it in spades. Even if you already used our action page to support Pete Hegseth, you can use it again. You can email and call more than once! **To support Pete Hegseth, go to our **[**Confirm Pete Hegseth action page**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a93e4cf8/1edb9794a93d4349)** right away.****
****Russell Vought
** Russell Vought recently testified (before the Senate Budget Committee) for the OMB role, and the left is just as determined to block him. He is also scheduled for a hearing with the Senate Budget Committee on January 22nd. Mr. Vought has served admirably in this capacity before--both as Deputy Director beginning in February 2018 and later as Acting Director and fully confirmed Director in July 2020. His record of dedication to America First principles makes him the right choice to oversee our nation's budget. **To support Russell Vought, go to our **[**Confirm Russell Vought action pag e**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a93e4cf8/1edb9794a93d434b)** right away.****
****To Support All of Them
** Check out our [**Confirm Trump 's Nominees action page**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a93e4cf8/1edb9794a93d434d "https://www.patriotproject.com/petition/trump-nominees") to send a single email supporting all of President Trump's nominees. However, certain nominees--like Pete Hegseth and Russell Vought--need extra attention beyond this general email. Please use their specific action pages (linked above) for focused support. For all other nominees, the **Confirm Trump 's Nominees** page will let you cover them in one go.
You can also visit our **[Support Trump 's Nominees hub](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a93e4cf8/1edb9794a93d434f "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/nominees")** to specifically support any of the other Cabinet nominees: just choose who you want to back, then click "Sign Petition." You can also read our letters of support and adapt them for letters to the editor or other advocacy efforts.
**The left has launched a full-on campaign --coined "Nix the Noms"--to flood Senate offices with calls and emails urging them to reject these nominees. We must match (and exceed) their intensity to ensure our senators don't just hear from left-wing activists.****
**Let 's stand together and make sure President Trump's administration starts with the right team in place. Thank you for taking action!
In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin **__** **** ************

Sen. Markwayne Mullin **[defended Pete Hegseth](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca0d95c-25b0-4e7f-88b0-7e3fb4c9d133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , Donald Trump's nominee for defense secretary, against critical questioning from CNN's Kaitlin Collins during a heated interview.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca0d95c-25b0-4e7f-88b0-7e3fb4c9d133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mullin argued that Hegseth's military resume **[should be the focus, not personal allegations.](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca0d95c-25b0-4e7f-88b0-7e3fb4c9d133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
"He's served our country honorably," Mullin told Collins. "We're talking about someone with combat experience, leadership in the military -- that's what matters."
The confirmation hearing saw Hegseth grilled over past allegations of misconduct and alcohol abuse. **[Mullin stood firm, suggesting that such scrutiny on personal life was unfair,](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca0d95c-25b0-4e7f-88b0-7e3fb4c9d133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at one point, asking sentators during the hearing if they themselveshave ever come to work drunk or even voted on legisslation while drunk.
Collins pressed Mullin on his comment, "How is the bad behavior of a senator a defense of someone who wants to run the Pentagon?"
"It's not," Mullin fired back. "What they were saying is he was incapable of doing his job, and if you're capable of doing your job and still drink on the job or late in the evening, then don't tell me Pete can't. And he's already said he won't drink!"
Mullin explained that Hegseth, a former Fox News contributor and Army veteran has the backing of many in the GOP because "he understands defense."
**[Watch the clash below:](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca0d95c-25b0-4e7f-88b0-7e3fb4c9d133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Pam Bondi, Trump's pick for Attorney General **[refused to be bullied by anti-Trump nut job Sen. Adam Schiff](https://substack.com/redirect/6ed7ea89-5ab8-4842-bebd-a3b726673c0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** when his questioning crossed the line into absurdity during yesterday's confirmation hearing.

In these tumultuous times, when so many in the political press and within the Democrat Party seem to be teaming up against me, it's comforting to know that I have friends who stand by me, unconditionally. I want to take this moment to express my deepest gratitude to Donald J. Trump, a man I've known for decades, and who has recently shown his unwavering support by posting "SAVE RUDY" on Truth Social.
Firstly, let me say, Mr. President, your gesture means more to me than you could possibly know. It's not just about the post; it's about the message it sends. It's about loyalty, something that's been the bedrock of our relationship from the very start. When I was the Mayor of New York City, you were there whenever we needed you. You understand the city's pulse, just as I did. We've walked through the streets of Manhattan together, not just as two New Yorkers, but as friends who shared a vision for a better, safer city...

Dear Fellow Patriot,

name: Tim Kaine
subject: Pete Hegseth refused to answer my questions
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2025]
Friends,
On Tuesday, President-elect Trump’s nominee for Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, appeared in a nomination hearing before the Senate Armed Services Committee. As a committee member, I had the opportunity to ask him questions — I hope you’ll read more below about our exchange.
During the hearing, I brought up concerning reports of Hegseth sexually assaulting and harassing women — including a 2017 incident in which Hegseth entered into a private settlement agreement with the accuser.
I asked him whether committing sexual assault is disqualifying to be Secretary of Defense.
Hegseth refused to answer the question.
I asked him why he failed to disclose the incident to the Trump Transition Team, or to the future Commander-in-Chief, as they considered him for this critical national security role.
Hegseth refused to answer the question.
I also asked him about troubling reports that he has shown up for work under the influence of alcohol, and whether that would be disqualifying for someone to be Secretary of Defense.
Once more, Hegseth refused to answer the question.
Look — I’ve served on the Senate Armed Services Committee since 2013. I have never voted against a nominee to be Secretary of Defense since I came to the Senate. I have voted to confirm five Secretaries of Defense under Administrations of both parties. So I want to be crystal clear when I say that my misgivings about Pete Hegseth are not political in nature.
The Secretary of Defense’s position of command over the U.S. military is second only to the President and Commander-in-Chief. They hold immense authority and responsibility for the safety of our country, and of the women and men who put their lives on the line on its behalf.
My role as a Senator is to carefully weigh the ability of the President-elect’s nominee to serve in this position, and based on this week's hearing and Hegseth’s repeated refusals to answer my questions, I hold grave concerns about the possibility of Pete Hegseth as our next Secretary of Defense .
As the public confirmation process moves forward, I will continue to carefully consider all the relevant and available information about Pete Hegseth — and all of President-elect Trump’s nominees. I take this process incredibly seriously, and I hope you’ll stay up-to-date with me throughout it.
Thanks for reading, and more to come soon.
-Tim Kaine

**Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**

**Statement from Indiana GOP Regarding Governor Braun’s Decision To Fly Flags At Full Staff For Donald Trump’s Inauguration** **INDIANAPOLIS (January 16, 2025)** – Indiana Republican Chairwoman Erin Lucas released the following statement regarding Governor Braun’s decision to fly our flags at full staff on January 20, 2025.

**“Monday, January 20, 2025, will be a historic day for our country, as Donald J. Trump will return to the White House and become our 47th President, and it’s the right decision by Governor Braun for our flags at state government facilities to be returned to full-staff for that one momentous day. With President Trump and Governor Braun’s leadership, their conservative policies will make our country great again, and it all begins on January 20, 2025.”** ###

ADEM Candidates,
Due to the devastating wildfires affecting our state and their impact on our communities, we are extending the California Democratic Party online ADEM voter registration deadline from January 24th to January 31st statewide.
Important Dates:
* If you register online by January 24th at 12:00 PM (Noon): You will receive your online ballot credentials according to the original schedule.
* If you register online between January 24th at 12:00 PM and January 31st at 12:00 PM: You will receive your online ballot credentials after registration closes.
* Final voting deadline: All votes must be submitted by February 23rd at 6:00 PM, either electronically or in-person.
The safety of our communities remains our top priority, and our thoughts are with all those affected by these wildfires.

2025 ADEM Results

name: Patti Reilly
subject: My police officer son is going to prison for doing his job
body:
My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.
Dear Peter,

My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.

And though you and I have never met, I’m praying you’ll help me save him.

Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aba5f6799c6e44fca36d8b568d7848ca&_e=vCZJA3JtCOKN43zHMRYiEewirFgeV-xm6XrIBVXsSsSvLkMRxfF0YYif0fCDzGdKzoCSJd-Jsy7DaNqLLqr7pbT7o7HHMoIemHvjj_Op_jV5Q1idlYt3HBMPL1RcuE8WKLXzlPrq2utmm6jYFfWSPwDtTsN8Zf6d9M6ZYKec3yTLtqMnRJQvN1tuEdoPyQguEfOO_c6ZB6pKQP5918MrZZ1SdBy13E5UazjQR1SIZg7fXM8M1Q-DNw4U03j70fIYZSyP-UC3b_CnCQgnRWA_XAJzCErfHuBKfuPwgJTsAC7-TTEuqMIzDliXvAuXVWzZMpp-gy4lQlNRdE3F4PrrFMabtS58PJRb47I8tNN0PN9o0KkCYfukLVfLBXp145tN9i-0NJvzI1iOoB2e4ssKzA%3D%3D)
He always dreamed of following in his dad’s footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy.

I was so proud that night.

Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **– murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.**

[**_I’m praying you will help me save my son_**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aba5f6799c6e44fca36d8b568d7848ca&_e=vCZJA3JtCOKN43zHMRYiEewirFgeV-xm6XrIBVXsSsSvLkMRxfF0YYif0fCDzGdKzoCSJd-Jsy7DaNqLLqr7pbT7o7HHMoIemHvjj_Op_jV5Q1idlYt3HBMPL1RcuE8WKLXzlPrq2utmm6jYFfWSPwDtTsN8Zf6d9M6ZYKec3yTLtqMnRJQvN1tuEdoPyQguEfOO_c6ZB6pKQP5918MrZZ1SdBy13E5UazjQR1SIZg58vkXoonwLCAWhkgJG-u0zDlV7pAL_uZj_YdPQnq_UIpx7qw5zsHFXfFHiFh5SXTXdBMDdA7Dmg4m5OcH9qZxTNsrjo_OcegHs9epNAGDYk8Aj-u8h6o6TfcJanbJY-OdZr4ASD85vyE8ljUTRPZZQZqMxmwwlKiGGGO6WHz493A%3D%3D) – **but first, let me explain what happened.** Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

Then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death.

**The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder.**

**Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced – to 5 1⁄2 years in prison.**

Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

But unless Terence’s appeal is successful, he’s going to prison – which is why I’m urgently turning to you for help today. The **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence’s defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal.

If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments.

We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence’s conviction.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone:

[**_Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF today?_**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aba5f6799c6e44fca36d8b568d7848ca&_e=vCZJA3JtCOKN43zHMRYiEewirFgeV-xm6XrIBVXsSsSvLkMRxfF0YYif0fCDzGdKzoCSJd-Jsy7DaNqLLqr7pbT7o7HHMoIemHvjj_Op_jV5Q1idlYt3HBMPL1RcuE8WKLXzlPrq2utmm6jYFfWSPwDtTsN8Zf6d9M6ZYKec3yTLtqMnRJQvN1tuEdoPyQguEfOO_c6ZB6pKQP5918MrZZ1SdBy13E5UazjQR1SIZg6m_900_SfCaPZqZqgLHShUrtgnMJZZtX8w5GA3DlfXqd9NTcZ_mKwssTGalCQ_pQimqCdXFxrRTiLQu33rDb7-TISREHo4Z-mNn_Du0mE6LZVSSSRi6qksu8Do0A8SdcoZK08xAy89UrYR2gmrChYLWM40ayDOMPbrad7kuAC01w%3D%3D)

I’m not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself – though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way.

[**_But your tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100, or more will help LELDF fully fund Terence’s appeal over the next 12 months._**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=aba5f6799c6e44fca36d8b568d7848ca&_e=vCZJA3JtCOKN43zHMRYiEewirFgeV-xm6XrIBVXsSsSvLkMRxfF0YYif0fCDzGdKzoCSJd-Jsy7DaNqLLqr7pbT7o7HHMoIemHvjj_Op_jV5Q1idlYt3HBMPL1RcuE8WKLXzlPrq2utmm6jYFfWSPwDtTsN8Zf6d9M6ZYKec3yTLtqMnRJQvN1tuEdoPyQguEfOO_c6ZB6pKQP5918MrZZ1SdBy13E5UazjQR1SIZg5LWHjpy94_uV7Ytu_pzLl_1a7W1Zx7rejCTohTrIBxvy0DyD0HI01Rc1lnGqUJ2w0GIA5oZvjpIW1uyQjeEnGNv5T7P-16ClDTM2Uujay00WVWHeOv7S4UnQWWX61R6CPGvJvIKQX8Qvou7d8RB_wRDxVzsrNXkS7KlhXYmNw11w%3D%3D) If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

Dear Peter, My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do. And though you and I have never met, I’m praying you’ll help me save him. Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy. He always dreamed of following in his dad’s footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy. I was so proud that night. Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch. – but first, let me explain what happened. Our nightmare started in October of 2020. Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory. Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge. When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter. Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs. My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car. Then it happened. Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car. After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn... Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy. They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist. There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires. Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death. The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder. Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced – to 5 1⁄2 years in prison. Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear. My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year! But unless Terence’s appeal is successful, he’s going to prison – which is why I’m urgently turning to you for help today. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence’s defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal. If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments. We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence’s conviction. So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone: I’m not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself – though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way. If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help. But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me. Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly. Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind folks like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today. And thank you in advance for helping LELDF support Terence and other wrongly accused officers. Gratefully, Patti Reilly P.S. Don’t get me wrong, I’m thankful the judge granted Terence bond so he doesn’t have to report to prison just yet. body:

| | |

| Dear Fellow American,

After four years, the discredited Biden-Harris team is leaving Washington next week...
...and Judicial Watch's work now is more important than ever!
**[That’s why I ask you to join the Judicial Watch team with a tax-deductible contribution today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

As the Trump administration takes office, here is just a sample of the work that we are counting on you to support!

* We expect Donald Trump to honor his pledge to end illegal immigration by all legal means...including **MASS DEPORTATION** of illegal aliens who do not qualify for amnesty...and we are building public support to make it clear that _no more delays_ in implementing our laws against illegal immigration will be tolerated!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* We are calling on the Trump team to shut down the **Deep State** for good...and we continue to use "open records laws" to expose and hold accountable government officials who during the Biden years corruptly weaponized the federal government against law-abiding Americans, especially conservatives.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* We are in court against **California, Illinois and Oregon** over their failure to clean their voter rolls as federal law requires...because keeping our elections honest requires persistent, sustained hard work, irrespective of the calendar.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

* And we continue to use the legal system and the courts in landmark challenges to "**reparations** " and other woke schemes that violate the constitutional principle of "equal protection under the laws.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=71950&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

_The opportunities facing Judicial Watch are great ...but the challenges are even greater!_

Thank you so much for your previous support of Judicial Watch. I deeply hope you will decide to stand with us again today as we fight for the rule of law and the American people’s “right to know.

Thomas Fitton
President

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 1/16/2025
body:
Weld County Republican legislators seek to repeal Colorado’s ‘cage-free’ eggs law
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Here is a summary of today's newsletter:
🏛️ **Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Senate Republicans have introduced a [regulatory rollback package](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) aimed at reducing specific fees and simplifying compliance for businesses. Meanwhile, another bill seeks to [repeal Colorado's cage-free egg law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which has contributed to rising costs and supply challenges for egg producers. Lastly, at least 21 members of this year’s Colorado General Assembly were initially appointed to their seats by a vacancy committee of party insiders: 12 state representatives and nine senators, with [all but three being Democrats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The FDA has issued an order yesterday that will [ban Red No. 3](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from food products and ingested drugs. a huge win for the MAHA movement. Meanwhile, it's been a busy week of Senate confirmation hearings over on the hill. Pam Bondi pledged to [depoliticize the DOJ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while Pete Hegseth vowed to reinstate and reimburse troops dismissed for [refusing COVID-19 vaccines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). John Ratcliffe focused on [countering global threats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) like China, and Colorado-native Chris Wright emphasized [restoring energy dominance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) through innovation and deregulation.
🗣️**Commentary Spotlight...** Wednesday’s announcement that an [agreement between Israel and Hamas](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) was near, providing for a temporary cease-fire and the release of 33 Israeli hostages, made clear that the “Trump Factor” played a pivotal role in pushing this deal forward.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, January 16, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Weld County Republican legislators seek to repeal Colorado’s ‘cage-free’ eggs law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A pair of Republican lawmakers are seeking to repeal Colorado’s “cage-free” eggs law, which went into full effect at the start of the year, citing the commodity’s price has increased more than any other food tracked.
Under 2020’s House Bill 1343, all eggs sold in Colorado are required to come from cage-free chickens starting on Jan. 1, 2025.
This year’s House Bill 1074, sponsored by Rep. Ryan Gonzalez, R-Greeley, and Sen. Barbara Kirkmeyer, R-Brighton, would repeal that law. The bill, which was introduced on Jan. 8, has been assigned to the Agriculture, Water & Natural Resources Committee.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Senate Republicans regulatory rollback package aimed at saving Colorado families $4,500 annually](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE SUM & SUBSTANCE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Senate Republicans introduced a regulatory rollback package aimed at reducing fees and regulations enacted since 2019. They argue this could save families an average of $4,500 annually.
* Proposals include repealing specific fees like the delivery fee, paper bag fee, and various energy-related costs. Additional measures target reformulated gas rebates, clean-air grant programs, and occupational licensing requirements.
* The package emphasizes addressing the state's affordability crisis, though it faces challenges gaining bipartisan support and balancing regulatory goals with cost reduction.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[How many lawmakers in 75th legislature got there through a vacancy appointment?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In 2025, 21 members of the Colorado legislature, including 12 state representatives and nine senators, were appointed via vacancy committees, representing roughly 20% of the 100-member body.
* Colorado's vacancy appointment process, managed by party insider committees, has faced increased scrutiny and reform attempts. Proposals, including special elections and barring appointees from running for reelection, have largely failed despite criticism from lawmakers and public calls for change.
* Nearly all appointees this year are Democrats, reflecting Colorado's political makeup. The appointment process contrasts with other states, where county commissions or governors often fill legislative vacancies.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Red dye banned by U.S. from foods 35 years after it was banned in cosmetics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The FDA has banned the use of Red No. 3 in food and ingested drugs, 35 years after it was prohibited in cosmetics due to evidence linking it to cancer.
* Red No. 3 is widely used in products such as candy, gum, cookies, and other foods, including Brach's candy corn, Betty Crocker sprinkles, and strawberry Ensure.
* The dye is already banned or restricted in countries like Australia, Japan, and across the European Union, reflecting global concerns about its safety.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Azani: Hostage deal shows Hamas took Trump’s ‘hell to pay’ threat seriously](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Incoming President Donald Trump has repeatedly issued stern warnings to Hamas in the past few weeks, saying that there will be “hell to pay” if Israeli hostages are not released by the time he returns to office on Jan. 20. Wednesday’s announcement that an agreement between Israel and Hamas was near, providing for a temporary cease-fire and the release of 33 Israeli hostages, made clear that the “Trump Factor” played a pivotal role in pushing this deal forward._
_These 33 Israeli hostages lates to be freed under the deal, along with 65 others still held by Hamas in Gaza in sub-human conditions for the past 466 days, were snatched from their homes and their beds on a Saturday morning of the Jewish holiday of Simchat on October 7, 2023. Ever since that day, their names and faces have become one with the Israeli collective._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[‘Colorado has told California to hold our beer’: Rep. Bradley warning it’s time for new direction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 15** _State Rep. Brandi Bradley, a Republican from House District 39 in Douglas County, won’t back down in the fight against government overreach. With the 75th General Assembly now in full swing, Bradley is focused on key bills she will pursue._
**[Ben Van Dyke wants to be voice of reason and of the people on Grand Junction City Council](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY LINDY BROWNING****| LOCAL | JANUARY 14** _Independent-minded, solution-oriented, and practical pragmatism is what Ben Van Dyke says is missing on the current Grand Junction City Council. He intends to change all that, for the residents and businesspeople in Grand Junction, if he is elected to City Council in April._
**[Rep. Winter asks Coloradans to ‘get out to the stock show’ and see the state’s $47 billion industry](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER****| STATE | JANUARY 14** _A leading voice of agriculture in the Colorado House, Rep. Ty Winter reminded urban and rural legislators alike Tuesday of the National Western Stock Show in Denver._ __

Here’s everything we’ve learned so far about Trump’s pick for Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth:
* **He’s __attacked women__ in our military, saying “we should not have women in combat roles”**
* **He’s been accused of __sexual assault__ and mistreatment of women in the workplace**
* **He won’t say no to shooting unarmed protesters**
* **He’s woefully __unqualified__ for the position**
* **He’s everything the Youth Vote has been fighting against!**

But despite the misogyny, accusations of assault, and lack of leadership, GOP senators are falling over themselves to pledge their support for Hegseth’s confirmation.
**We’re making it clear to the Youth Vote that Hegseth isn’t just extreme. He’s a direct threat to the future of this country.**
[We have to be ready to prepare young activists to organize against the worst of Trump’s extreme agenda. But doing so requires serious resources. | | | It's Sean Feucht— if you've been following Let Us Worship, you've seen the way the church has stepped up and come alongside the victims of the California wildfires. People took note too. Fearless Church in Los Angeles invited us to partner with them on another night of praise, worship, and aid distribution to victims of the wildfires. **TONIGHT** , we will gather at Fearless Church (1611 S Hope St. Los Angeles) to be the hands and feet of Jesus. We are putting out the call for believers in the area to step up and join us by bringing relief supplies. I included a list of the items being collected. If you can't attend but would like to bless the evacuees and firefighters we will be ministering to, you can contribute **[HERE](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=a244f5fdcd0a4e7db328c640308e1584&_e=dc1NWd80GUOyNeS4JSlP4QprP1HIWUOFuaajtood6tmCPc99sM83Qi8elxyrlfYMokxt_BqOw423oKieciyEnnu3Oydmkwa3LMumC6mJqioPe3vUdJpFTv7w5VwAe5W7EhTBwNPk2Dv3nsoSu9NSUeHTFNaIt-jhrzUaG4PoqQUnULDezWHvPe3_yDRcIiTgKcQeBwSDyK7e5Pd5YkKltr6rKmhxERT-EwfPMb95dKFEpNv6rzeEwaRS-4Tii3GWI2-fpC7eIjY8i3S4pRU9FFT3VWKS6FerW1n28sLxXs0lTZ8K12tF_UrYcJF5gTmr)** or at the links below. Dear Friend,
---
When the church shows the love of Christ, the world takes notice. We put out a call for Believers to show the love of Christ to our brothers and sisters impacted by the California wildfires. And you stepped up in an eternal way.

Thanks to Believers from across the country, we were able to bless those impacted by the wildfires with prayer, aid and financial support. And we're asking you to do it again. Our friends at Fearless Church saw what happened at Angelus Temple and invited us to come bring in aid and minister to evacuees and fire fighters **TOMORROW NIGHT**.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=dcac8242330e4c15a55d3b915d5debd3&_m=a244f5fdcd0a4e7db328c640308e1584&_e=dc1NWd80GUOyNeS4JSlP4QprP1HIWUOFuaajtood6tmCPc99sM83Qi8elxyrlfYMokxt_BqOw423oKieciyEnnu3Oydmkwa3LMumC6mJqioPe3vUdJpFTv7w5VwAe5W7EhTBwNPk2Dv3nsoSu9NSUeHTFNaIt-jhrzUaG4PoqQVzaaNypIde4_JSFfCyjNDU3akdDR70CAWxRTRzd9fQoqDzPMTobPaLTilhkaR3avGkRIL6SMCzRmsQnOx0EPdYj60tlW9LSr237XG3zati_qfxQRmjLGNCfTIGN-i5R_vEwwY268U1ZOg9WpYuyEvT)
---
I can't give enough thanks to the countless Believers who have already donated to help bless the victims of the California wildfires. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I take those three words seriously
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
These hearings are job interviews.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2460%2E4032634%2EUf4T44)
---
It’s right there in the Constitution: the president makes nominations and appointments with the “Advice and Consent” of the U.S. Senate. I take those three words seriously. So as we begin to hold confirmation hearings for Donald Trump’s Cabinet nominees, I’m fulfilling my oath to uphold the Constitution and doing my due diligence. My first hearing this week was for Pete Hegseth. I’ve been ringing alarm bells over his nomination to be Secretary of Defense. This is someone who’s been credibly accused of sexual assault, who ran not one but two nonprofits into the ground, who got so drunk at work events that colleagues felt they had to carry him back to his room, and who’s said women shouldn’t serve in combat. In his hearing before the Senate Armed Services Committee, I asked him directly about those statements. I put them on the record. And I showed how he changed his tune just 32 days after the most recent of his degrading statements about women in combat roles — right after Trump nominated him for this job. These confirmation proceedings are job interviews, and I will keep seeking answers on behalf of the American people. Today, I’ll get a chance to question Scott Bessent and Scott Turner, Trump’s nominees to run the Treasury Department and the Housing and Urban Development Department, respectively. I’ve already each sent them letters with over 250 questions combined about their views, their record, and their plans. For example, I asked Bessent about his work as a hedge fund manager and the extent to which he and his associates would benefit from Trump’s tax breaks — and other policies that favor the wealthy and big businesses. And I asked Turner for details about how he plans to tackle the housing affordability crisis, because although he’s described the author of Project 2025’s housing agenda as a “mentor,” there’s not much information out there about how he’d approach this job. **Even if Senate Republicans are willing to rubberstamp even the least qualified, most extreme of Trump’s nominees, Senate Democrats’ job is to not roll over and play dead.** **We must do our homework and expose the facts, as loudly and as clearly as we can.** We can’t stop every nomination. But in Trump’s first term, by asking tough questions and holding the Senate floor for hours to slow down confirmation and expose GOP extremism, Senate Democrats were able to doom some nominations, lay the groundwork for Cabinet officials to later resign in disgrace, and bring scrutiny that put some constraints on Trump’s efforts. This is one example of how Senate Democrats can show up and actually limit the damage of the Trump administration over the next four years. I’m going to do everything in my power to keep up this fight. I’m grateful to the people of Massachusetts for trusting me with this role, and I’m grateful to youfor powering this work. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

name: Rashida Tlaib
subject: Justice Democrats stood with me; help me stand with them.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justice Democrats stood with me when I first ran for Congress in 2018,
when I was up for re-election in 2020, 2022, and 2024, and when I was
censured by House colleagues for leading the call for a ceasefire and
lasting peace in Palestine as the only Palestinian-American member of
Congress.

AIPAC — and its network of right-wing megadonor-funded super PACs —
promised to do everything in their power to unseat me last November, and
thanks to this people-powered movement, they failed miserably. But they
did defeat a number of other pro-Palestine progressives in Democratic
primaries, spending over $100 million to do so. That kind of money makes
it even harder for working-class candidates to run for office.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250116-1?refcode=em20250116-36323&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36323_1203867_ACu2Sh&akid=36323%2E1203867%2EACu2Sh ]So I’m asking you: Will you make a grassroots donation to fuel Justice
Democrats’ 2026 Candidate Recruitment fund?

During my time in Congress, I’ve faced attacks from far-right Republicans
and from corporate, establishment Democrats. Instead of fighting for the
people we were elected to serve, they’re trying to undermine progressive
leaders for demanding the changes that our communities need in order to
thrive.

Too many members of both parties have been bought off by billionaires and
corporate interests. That’s why I’ve introduced legislation to stop
politicians from profiting from war and to take on corporate influence in
politics. Many of my colleagues are directly profiting when they vote to
support the weapons industry or the fossil fuel industry, which is
unacceptable. Instead of listening to their constituents, many members of
Congress are trying to criminalize people exercising their right to
protest and free speech.

As the proud daughter of a UAW member and Ford assembly line worker, I’ve
witnessed firsthand the difference between politicians who ignore everyday
people and don’t understand the urgency of the crises our communities face
vs. the working-class leaders who understand their neighbors’ struggles
and are actually fighting for the transformative changes our communities
need. Everyone deserves government representatives who truly represent
them, but many of my colleagues in Congress are millionaires and want to
preserve the unjust status quo. The American people see this and are
losing faith in the Democratic Party, which partly explains the massive
drop in Democratic voter turnout last November.

That’s why it’s so important for Justice Democrats to build the resources
needed to recruit, support, and elect as many working-class candidates as
possible between now and Democratic primaries early next year.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250116-1?refcode=em20250116-36323&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36323_1203867_ACu2Sh&akid=36323%2E1203867%2EACu2Sh ]Please pitch in $5 or whatever you can to help Justice
Democrats reach their $100,000 Candidate Recruitment goal by February 1.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250116-1?refcode=em20250116-36323&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36323_1203867_ACu2Sh&akid=36323%2E1203867%2EACu2Sh ]Contribute $5

As billionaire spending in elections keeps growing, our progressive and
working-class movement depends on grassroots donations from everyday
people — rather than big checks from corporate PACs.

Thanks for anything you can give to help us transform the Democratic Party
for the better and recenter our focus on the people.

In solidarity,

Rashida

[23]Photo of Rashida Tlaib

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250116-36323-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36323_1203867_ACu2Sh&akid=36323%2E1203867%2EACu2Sh

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. # Gov. Braun closes DEI office, mandates return-to-work in slew of executive orders
---
| | **The Indianapolis Star **
**Kayla Dwyer **
**January 15, 2025 ** [https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2025/01/15/banning-dei-return-to-work-gov-mike-braun-signs-executive-orders/77721150007/](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=f197b6e1754a4f5883da6f2502ac5288&_e=dCpycw3BNv80PHWghEWjzCgGvkRSte92IeCS2l2P4SlgMU6QjnsVG_dBD0hK1ZPtOA38P5wx5Up5ASw1MA-4v9Zmx5zluFF2vG_-n6tw3J4d87nNnWvn4n9o-jSoADEtlsE11uHZ6JZjTqH7_Qmw7_WeBykDCJ5U-9adULigRhUh0AfdJhptSWbGsASW-vOSE3efLNr8mYmV4vmoKsEy3NSa0rRQNJVSv1J8hqfDusx3gsQte_wHGpG6rwe7Dcx6SLgZwE-zXq_HGyw37DnFYzuuIyU2gBmvpF3s2DBN1VLi4BnsL9AjFYYxMOOL4COwuUijDjS-BTRex_K1tOxgBdb52N0YbVMYowpdQ53KHR4%3D) On his second full day in office, Gov. Mike Braun signed a slew of executive orders under the general theme of government efficiency ― among them, orders to rid the state government of any diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives, mandate in-office work for state employees and remove degree requirements for state jobs. "You can see what this is about," he told reporters in his newly occupied governor's office, standing before a wall that's now blank, waiting for him to choose his own portraits to hang. "Making Indiana government more efficient, more transparent, more accountable. Every decision is being made with the goal of improving services for Hoosiers and maximizing the value of taxpayer dollars." As governor, Braun has the power to enact orders that affect the functioning and organization of the executive branch.

**Braun is closing Holcomb's DEI office** Braun's executive order banishing DEI initiatives from state government includes closing the Office of the Chief Equity, Inclusion and Opportunity Officer ― a cabinet position outgoing Gov. Eric Holcomb created in 2020 following the criminal justice protests across the nation and in Indianapolis that year.
**The end of remote work for state employees** The state first allowed government employees to work from home in March 2020, when the COVID-19 pandemic surged. Holcomb also issued an executive order mandating a full return to work in 2021, and yet according to Braun's executive order, executive branch employees logged more than 7 million hours of remote work in 2024 alone. Now, Braun is ordering full-time state employees to begin working in person every day by July 1. "We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and believe this will foster a stronger and more connected state workforce," he said.

**Removing college degree requirements for state jobs** One of Braun's executive orders directs the state personnel department to review all state job postings to determine if a college degree is "necessary to perform the job duties." If it isn't, he says, get rid of that requirement. Braun wants to see degree requirements replaced with skills and experience-based standards. "In the enterprise I ran for 37 years, some of our best employees were just good at what they wanted to come and do for you," he said, referring to his company Meyer Distributing. "This is going to attract a broader pool of talent. I know it works."
