| | | Friends,

I’m Eric Teetsel, Executive V.P. at the Center for Renewing America. I hope to connect with many of you in the coming weeks and months on a more personal level, but in the meantime I wanted to share a quick update on our work at the Center.

We’re about to enter a new chapter in American history.

Trump’s second inauguration is almost upon us and we have a real opportunity to take the battle to the woke and weaponized deep state. That means things are about to intensify.

As you may have heard, our President Russ Vought has been nominated to become the Director of the Office of Management and Budget. As he said [during his opening statement](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d3901a5d91&e=17913c7d6d) from yesterday’s confirmation hearing, “ _The President has promised the American people a federal government that works for all Americans, not the interests of bureaucrats and an entrenched establishment.”_

We wish him the best and CRA will be fully supporting him through the process.

In the meantime, we’ve been hard at work researching and proposing ideas that will help ensure conservative policies become a reality.

Here’s a review of what we’ve been up to in recent weeks.
---
| [**Op-Ed:
The Importance of Trump’s Greenland Stance for National Renewal**](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=2431f0bf23&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1f1860a7a1&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| I recently wrote an op-ed [about Trump’s comments on Greenland](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=67e90dd152&e=17913c7d6d) for _World_. In the op-ed, I broke down both the validity of what Trump is saying and why his stance is key to the revitalization of our nation.

Greenland is a resource rich land that sits in a strategically important region close to our two biggest geopolitical rivals in Russia and China. It’s imperative that we have an Arctic policy that involves Greenland in order to secure both our national security and economic interests.

Of equal importance, Trump’s rhetoric signals a shift in American foreign policy away from the nation-building of previous regimes and toward prioritizing our nation’s interests. He has also reintroduced the ideas of exploration and expansion that have always been part of the American ethos, but were dormant for several generations.

As I wrote in the piece, Trump’s foreign policy _“is about renewing our spirit as a nation destined for greatness on the world stage, able to provide for itself, and ruthless in defense of itself.”_

Trump’s stance on Greenland is as much about the renewal of America as it is anything else. [Please read the full op-ed](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=c7eb0ecb69&e=17913c7d6d).
---
| [**CRA's Complaint Against Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson**](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=ebf30e8ab2&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5dd327af42&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| Recently, we filed an [ethics complaint](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0beca383fa&e=17913c7d6d) against Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson for failing to properly disclose income from her husband’s medical malpractice business, along with unknown funding for her supreme court induction ceremony at the Library of Congress.

As a direct result of our complaint, Justice Jackson has since filed an amended financial disclosure. In predictable fashion, the partisan press have done their best to ignore this story.

Our actions did [receive coverage](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=484509a4f5&e=17913c7d6d) in The Hill, who published a quote from CRA Communications Director Rachel Cauley calling out the media’s blackout on this topic:

_“It’s a sad commentary that the media does not care about liberal justices not following the ethics disclosure rules and a think tank needs to file a complaint to get it covered and effect change.”_

Rachel also slammed the media [in a post on X](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7af3da858a&e=17913c7d6d). The degree to which the media runs interference for the left never ceases to amaze us. At CRA, we remain committed to doing whatever it takes to expose the corruption of the left, and publicize it to as wide an audience as possible.
---
| [**CRA Senior Fellow Jeff Clark’s Legal Battle Against DC Cartel Continues**](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=8deffde3cb&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=e9cc5452cb&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| They just won’t leave him alone. CRA Senior Fellow and former Trump DOJ official Jeff Clark is embroiled in another [legal battle](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0d18436b2f&e=17913c7d6d) after the DC bar moved to suspend his law license.

This is just the latest chapter in the DC cartel’s witch hunt against an honest, patriotic public official. His only sin is asking legal, fully warranted questions regarding the integrity of the 2020 presidential election results in the state of Georgia.

We have chronicled everything Jeff has been through in our recent production _Fearless at the Point of Attack: The Jeff Clark Story,_ which you can [watch here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=0b1001bea9&e=17913c7d6d). President Trump [publicly recognized](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=e9ee3f4904&e=17913c7d6d) Jeff’s courage and called him _“fantastic”_ after seeing him at a recent event.

We’re proud to call Jeff our colleague and ally in the fight for the future of our country, and will stand by him through any and all attacks. The America First movement needs fighters, and he is one of our best.
---
| [**The Debate Over H-1B Visas**](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3e42624d94&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=46a4f953d6&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| There has been a lot of talk recently over the value of H-1B visas and American immigration policy. CRA Senior Fellow Ken Cuccinelli published a [policy brief](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=aa24555440&e=17913c7d6d) on this topic back in May of 2022 titled _The H-1B Visa Program Harms American Workers and Should Be Repealed._

This brief breaks down the history of the H-1B program and how it affects the American worker. It’s a must read for anyone who wants to understand this issue better.

As my colleague Wade Miller [said on X](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=625212c0bd&e=17913c7d6d), the program _“is a big problem and it does harm American workers.”_
---
| **The Next Four Years Will Be Critical for American Renewal**
---
| Friends, we’re about to enter an incredibly important time period in our country’s history. We have a golden opportunity to put God, country, and community back at the center of American life.

My goal for the Center is for it to continue to be the intellectual nerve center for the America First movement, and to fight and win the policy battles ahead.

American renewal is possible, and we’re going to do everything in our power over the next few years to make it a reality.

[Thanks in advance for your support](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=76754ee762&e=17913c7d6d).

Sincerely,

Eric Teetsel
_Executive Vice President_
**Center for Renewing America**

As an Air Force veteran, I find Hegseth’s comments about women in the military reprehensible. I served because I, like the **two million** female veterans in the U.S. today, had valuable skills that our country needed.
Hegseth shouldn’t even be under consideration for multiple reasons, any one of which would, in normal times, be disqualifying:
* His inability to run a small organization – let alone one as large as the Pentagon;
* His challenges with alcohol;
* The allegations of sexual assault and harassment in the workplace against him.

Like you, I don’t have much of a say in this – only Senators do. But we can still speak out.
**I'm standing against Pete Hegseth's appointment. Will you join me?**
**Yes, I want to add my name to the list of people opposing Pete Hegseth’s confirmation as Secretary of Defense!**

name: Tom Barrett
subject: I took the Oath
body:
I was proud to take the Oath of Office as a new Member of Congress | | | **I Took the Oath**
---
| On January 3, 2025, I was proud to stand with my family and take the Oath of Office as a member of U.S. House of Representatives in the 119th Congress. I was sworn in by Speaker of the House Mike Johnson and joined by my wife and children, my parents, and my wife’s parents. After 22 years in the United States Army, it is a great honor to take this oath and work to Make America Great Again!
---
|
---
Without you and thousands of other patriots who supported my campaign, this great honor would not have happened. Thank you for your trust in me and I promise to fight for the things we campaigned on: securing our border, cutting wasteful spending and lowering inflation, ending the scourge of crime across the nation, and fighting the Woke Agenda.
---
[_ _ Support Tom _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=678961f93e8fc179679fcd31&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftake-the-oath&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67894442c2081171d3123c17&l=en-US&s=h9gbLU9tXFzB-TeuoAoBnoO0Gpc%3D)
---
I was also honored to [move into the office once occupied by my great grandfather, Louis C. Rabaut,](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=678961f93e8fc179679fcd31&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.detroitnews.com%2Fstory%2Fnews%2Fpolitics%2F2025%2F01%2F03%2Fmichigan-congressman-tom-barrett-moves-into-house-office-his-great-grandfather-once-occupied%2F77427666007%2F&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67894442c2081171d3123c17&l=en-US&s=QtEJdtdxdP-2uqXfFS7U87oqjhE%3D) who served in Congress throughout World War II, and was famous for authoring the legislation adding “Under God” to our Pledge of Allegiance. He recognized that the biggest difference between the U.S.A. and U.S.S.R. was our belief in _The Almighty_ , so he authored the bill that officially added the phrase.
---
|
---
| _Here is a photo of me with my father, Patrick, and my youngest son, Louis (“Big Lou”), who was named after my great grandfather, former Congressman Louis C. Rabaut, as we moved into his office._
---
[_ _ Join the 2026 Team _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=678961f93e8fc179679fcd31&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftake-the-oath&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67894442c2081171d3123c17&l=en-US&s=h9gbLU9tXFzB-TeuoAoBnoO0Gpc%3D)
---
**But as exciting as the past few weeks have been, there is a reality – I am the top targeted House Republican in the nation.** When I announced my candidacy in July 2023, our race for a Democrat-held seat was immediately labeled the most competitive seat in the nation and the top target for Republicans. Our victory was one of just a handful of seats in the nation to flip from Democrat to Republican and critical to our narrow 4-seat majority.**Now, the target is on my back, and I need your help again.**
---
[_ _ Help Tom Get Ready _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=678961f93e8fc179679fcd31&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftake-the-oath&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67894442c2081171d3123c17&l=en-US&s=h9gbLU9tXFzB-TeuoAoBnoO0Gpc%3D)
---
Last month, the House Majority PAC, which was founded by Nancy Pelosi and is funded by George Soros, announced that I am one of their top targets for defeat in 2026. Before I’d even taken a vote, they announced that they are coming after me to get control of Congress and stop President Trump’s agenda.You were key to my victory less than three months ago and now I hope you can help me start early and fight back against Pelosi and the House Majority PAC. _**Can you send a donation for my re-election campaign in the enclosed envelope? Any amount, whether $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, or the maximum $3,300 will help us get started.**_**More than $20 million was spent against me in the 2024 election** – and now that I’m a top target for Washington Democrats – I expect them to come with even more. They can only win by beating incumbents and my seat is their best opportunity.
---
[_ _ Make a Donation _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=678961f93e8fc179679fcd31&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Ftake-the-oath&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67894442c2081171d3123c17&l=en-US&s=h9gbLU9tXFzB-TeuoAoBnoO0Gpc%3D)
---
My promise to you is this: I will take nothing for granted. I will fight hard in Washington for the things I was elected to do. # Join Us in Supporting Altadena Fire Victims
---
[](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=76c4c2a36d&e=7b1b739a89)
| Dear Friends,
I hope this message finds you well. I want to share a heartbreaking story about a family affected by the recent Eaton Fire in Altadena and invite you to join us in our efforts to help them and others in need.
The Sawyer Family's Struggle
Lydia Sawyer, her husband Tom, and their elderly uncle Richard have lived in their home for nearly 40 years. Tragically, they lost everything in the fire, including the memories and stability they had built for their three grandchildren, whom they are raising. As Lydia stood before the charred remains of their home, she struggled to hold back tears, knowing that she would have to explain this devastating loss to the children. To add to their heartbreak, their insurance won’t cover their losses due to a missed payment.
How You Can Help
This Sunday, January 19th, from 12 PM to 3 PM, I am partnering with Hon. Chris Holden, the Hospital Association of Southern California, and Hope the Mission to host a donation drive for families like the Sawyers. We are also inviting the Sawyer family to the event to provide them with direct financial assistance that day.
_Donation Drive Details:_
_\- Date: Sunday, January 19th_
_\- Time: 12 PM - 3 PM_
_\- Location: Pasadena Unified School District_
_351 S Hudson Street, Pasadena, CA 91101_
We are collecting essential items such as blankets, clothes, diapers, hygiene products, pet food and more. If you would like to provide financial support, please donate using this [link](https://drasifmahmood.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=306598b2f3a0f328de4c6676e&id=63162f3381&e=7b1b739a89) or button below:
Your support can make a significant difference during this difficult time. Together, we can bring hope and assistance to those who need it most.
Thank you for your generosity.
Sincerely,
Asif

name: Patti Reilly
subject: Help me save my son
body:
Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.
Dear Fellow American,

My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.

And though you and I have never met, I’m praying you’ll help me save him.

Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DPQyFO0Dm7F0m25H3J31ij7Xpx8ygGpMVZebifN0WY6H57PLEhvgaICIprrJKWpxq-_OfOzneR9nrrTmQvsTtB5BR2zG9f0bbRg_-W72iwo0ubtkNpvRzKzDlNxWvwgOGMO8hHgj6yxQ2wEYkncNoHuPCGZGzREOBeRQto-NFkikw%3D%3D)
He always dreamed of following in his dad’s footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy.

I was so proud that night.

Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **– murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch.**

[**_I’m praying you will help me save my son_**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DOWNYoqHBPoA3ZWwLRJUEB4YczYcd6x9_lfsUrs4uZ5cAr7olKVijNbiLfepQ6wRev53dbKbDqfnGlyoZUfNRes35zLGhfuNrGJkvYvF4e9PU4CoaM974em6e5c-0B8KhXLi22jCETLYt-gRLqXD52YieQVZCTYeZ_Ir7Vpr-mthQ%3D%3D) – **but first, let me explain what happened.** Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

Then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death.

**The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder.**

**Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced – to 5 1⁄2 years in prison.**

Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

But unless Terence’s appeal is successful, he’s going to prison – which is why I’m urgently turning to you for help today. The **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence’s defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal.

If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments.

We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence’s conviction.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone:

[**_Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF today?_**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DNJwV1JJImU4n_09uLveQDlIPFEO2B0k5QaD0qdgzAy7mH6DxU0Lu1dPuMoz3a1gvwCVbabboMwdhorFyXikrbxsFaiHvOCQEvqkYStljfXM-i7lvx_S_3imo20xakioRaXKzNtVbyckL-bO19ko90rmnbKSMI5J0F8izJbuiv88w%3D%3D)

I’m not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself – though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way.

[**_But your tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100, or more will help LELDF fully fund Terence’s appeal over the next 12 months._**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DNanLW0qt2vpOpd7D2a4wNJBVQCRHWTj4ZM0PMH006Sy7MjBIZLuVdsvRrDwPeaXATCzUnQaC8G2HdVkqo79ePbeNEVt_Y_fHEXKIAcU19FtwKHxLMLn2WWZw5-WRY-46LgGhbg-7oYpY7Nxi-Dfu1snc26r09IoCSjdXM9JcWxDA%3D%3D) If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

[**_So if you are at all able, please follow this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence._**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DMlalbsm8je7taD8cplfqjM3cslWl69rGCQ75boqAseQa5jyQG5WtpSRIvL5sRLjeGNQjcifVdDilu7C7iEECmbdY0Tw5WpqYA8QbpHTQg3fEbJ0bT4TNpX-Lf1ihKY4-RdvJgDh_N4PYnyQ4gnnfu-TPRauQvdWyuBQx33MLi5NQ%3D%3D)

**Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind folks like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you in advance for helping LELDF support Terence and other wrongly accused officers.

Gratefully,
**Patti Reilly**

P.S. Don’t get me wrong, I’m thankful the judge granted Terence bond so he doesn’t have to report to prison just yet. Hopefully it never comes to that... but to get Terence’s conviction overturned, it’s going to cost at least $150,000 to fund his appeal. [**_Will you please help me save my son by making an urgent tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to LELDF today?_**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=60194d7e1f1e4d15944d4502eda82af0&_e=bUYj7T2qlig2SmME4xwJXybfonlzjIZSA22a3EQ0nA0xE1nJul-SH_u3ih9o8bgWGm38jN6XPF7kYUN498B6I9iTAXPzcv_uAREc_LsRKOQjD_Rd_vYgC7u5mT_wtQZ-AupCIHNY6k6psZHj--X3_9CVa-vUXpVVt-LhwjO6UDvyK-JxXRY4RQuE1RA4Nfjp3tq4NqEgkUK-2fIAJvLi7ZFglfrgS6lju_8yjTLX6DMDvnlwzniNfF8ZmpVc5iyiqOH0snokK1VHuR1rzi-91Ym94W776qw0VJkJKgWOfrIo0hv-9_PR4JlooahSLcPs6Njgx9LeBGQD8tMMAWcxtsGx3zMOsrSnRKb4ki7ZBqVqTfU3YqmSzeXoyflV0A9yEgh67CcAFhHhg06-qoEJyQ%3D%3D) Thank you for standing with Terence during this nightmare.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

clean_body: Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch. Dear Fellow American, My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do. And though you and I have never met, I’m praying you’ll help me save him. Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy. He always dreamed of following in his dad’s footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy. I was so proud that night. Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be wrongfully convicted of murder – murder of a criminal my son didn’t even touch. – but first, let me explain what happened. Our nightmare started in October of 2020. Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang’s territory. Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long – including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge. When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter. Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs. My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car. Then it happened. Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car. After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here’s where the story takes a shocking turn... Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd’s death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy. They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist. There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires. Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon’s death. The pressure campaign worked and prosecutors charged my son with Second-Degree Murder. Terence was convicted in December 2022 and he was finally just sentenced – to 5 1⁄2 years in prison. Now you understand why I’m so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear. My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year! But unless Terence’s appeal is successful, he’s going to prison – which is why I’m urgently turning to you for help today. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has stepped forward to pay for Terence’s defense and is actively raising funds to pay for the appeal. If you’ve ever heard of LELDF, you know they’re a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence for over 30 years. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops – and their families – at their lowest moments. We expect it will cost at least $150,000 to appeal Terence’s conviction. So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I’ve ever asked anyone: I’m not asking you to donate the entire $150,000 yourself – though it would be a huge weight off our shoulders if you are able to help that way. If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn’t be so bold as to ask for your help. But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. I simply can’t bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me. Any amount – $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more – will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly. Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind folks like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today. And thank you in advance for helping LELDF support Terence and other wrongly accused officers. Gratefully, Patti Reilly P.S. Don’t get me wrong, I’m thankful the judge granted Terence bond so he doesn’t have to report to prison just yet. Hopefully it never comes to that... but to get Terence’s conviction overturned, it’s going to cost at least $150,000 to fund his appeal. Thank you for standing with Terence during this nightmare. More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visitwww.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue Lives Matter! Peter — we’re facing what feels like a dark moment in our nation’s history. But we know that leading with our values is the best path forward. Becca’s life experiences have prepared her to take on tough conversations. And we wanted to share one of those experiences with you today: When Becca and her wife first moved to Brattleboro, they were taken aback when they first saw their new neighbor’s yard. **Right out on their front lawn was an anti-LGBTQ+ sign.** Becca thought to herself, _“How are we going to make this work?”_ At that moment, it felt like there was much more than just a fence dividing them. But a friendly wave turned into a conversation, which turned into a borrowed lawn mower — and things changed. The sign came down, and with it, so did a barrier between neighbors. During such a polarizing era in our politics, we’re sure a lot of you have faced similar conversations with your family, friends, and neighbors. We hope this serves as a reminder that when we stop turning away from each other, real connections and understanding can happen. **Becca believes that the way forward lies in conversations like these.** She’ll never back away from fighting for what’s right — she’s done it in her neighborhood, and she’ll continue to do so as Vermont’s representative in Congress. **[There are plenty more tough conversations ahead of us, Peter, and Becca is up for the challenge. Becca’s life experiences have prepared her to take on tough conversations. And we wanted to share one of those experiences with you today: When Becca and her wife first moved to Brattleboro, they were taken aback when they first saw their new neighbor’s yard. Right out on their front lawn was an anti-LGBTQ+ sign. Becca thought to herself, “How are we going to make this work?” At that moment, it felt like there was much more than just a fence dividing them. But a friendly wave turned into a conversation, which turned into a borrowed lawn mower — and things changed. The sign came down, and with it, so did a barrier between neighbors. During such a polarizing era in our politics, we’re sure a lot of you have faced similar conversations with your family, friends, and neighbors. We hope this serves as a reminder that when we stop turning away from each other, real connections and understanding can happen. Becca believes that the way forward lies in conversations like these. subject: My first piece of legislation in Congress
body:
|
#
Folks, The Great Lakes were a cherished part of my childhood in Michigan, and now, as a parent, I’m even more determined to ensure their beauty is preserved for generations to come. They’re not just important – they’re a part of who we are. From creating _thousands_ of jobs to providing the stunning recreational spaces we hold dear, the Great Lakes are at the heart of our community and way of life. **That’s why I recently introduced my very first piece of legislation in Congress: the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Act of 2025.** Through a $500 million investment, this legislation will reauthorize the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative, a program that has been critical in preserving the lakes by stopping the spread of invasive species, restoring coastline, and preventing future contamination. My Michigan colleagues in the House – Democrats and Republicans alike – are also co-sponsors of this critical bill. Now, we need it to get onto the House floor. Can you help me send a message that we need this legislation passed? clean_body: | Folks, The Great Lakes were a cherished part of my childhood in Michigan, and now, as a parent, I’m even more determined to ensure their beauty is preserved for generations to come. They’re not just important – they’re a part of who we are. From creating thousands of jobs to providing the stunning recreational spaces we hold dear, the Great Lakes are at the heart of our community and way of life. That’s why I recently introduced my very first piece of legislation in Congress: the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative (GLRI) Act of 2025. Through a $500 million investment, this legislation will reauthorize the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative, a program that has been critical in preserving the lakes by stopping the spread of invasive species, restoring coastline, and preventing future contamination. My Michigan colleagues in the House – Democrats and Republicans alike – are also co-sponsors of this critical bill. Now, we need it to get onto the House floor. Can you help me send a message that we need this legislation passed? | | Since 2010, the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative has provided over $4 billion in funding to nearly 8,000 projects, so we know just how well this program works. Congress has an opportunity to build on that success by passing this legislation. Thanks for signing, Kristen | = | We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . clean_body: Redwood Matters: News from the League | January 16, 2025 | As we share this newsletter, our hearts go out to everyone impacted by the devastating wildfires in Southern California. We thank the courageous first responders and stand in solidarity with our park partners and all affected communities. | Mark your calendars It's been a rough start for many of us, but there’s still plenty to anticipate in the months ahead. From birdwatching to slug spotting, free park days to film releases, redwoods celebrations to forest restorations, here’s what we’re looking forward to in 2025. Sonoma Coast success Redwood fans from New Zealand to the Netherlands showed their love for the forest, helping us meet our $9 million fundraising goal for Sonoma Coast Redwoods. Together, we successfully acquired and protected this stunning place for all. Redwood the musical You and a guest can catch Idina Menzel on Broadway in a new musical about adventure and resilience in a majestic redwood forest. Enter to win—or use promo code SAVEREDWOODS for an exclusive for League members. Outdoor escapes Misty and magical, the redwoods get downright dreamy in winter. Check out some of our favorite trails, from an accessible loop past towering trees to a magic carpet ride through a sea of bright green redwood sorrel. Paying it forward “We feel very strongly that this could help save us environmentally,” says Candy Pelissero on the importance of connecting young people to the forest—a need she meets by funding League education programs. Peter, last night, President Biden delivered his farewell address — bringing 50 years of dedicated service to the American people to a close. We couldn’t be sadder to see him go, but we also couldn’t be more grateful for all that the Biden-Harris administration has accomplished for the Peach State: 🏥 **1.3 million** Georgians signed up for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act
💊 Prescription drug costs cut for **1.9 million** seniors and Medicare beneficiaries
💼 **493,300** new jobs created
📝 **1.1 million** applications to start new businesses

Hey there, Peter, This week I outlined my vision and priorities in my annual State of the State speech. My focus is clear and unwavering — it’s all about making real strides on issues that matter most to Oregonians. You know me, I don’t shy away from our biggest challenges. I’m always in for the long haul to drive results for our whole state. These issues don’t have quick fixes. They need dedication, strategy, and stubborn focus. As we look ahead, I’m laser-focused on getting closer to an Oregon where: 🏡No one has to live in a tent on a sidewalk. This means addressing the housing and homelessness crises head-on and tackling these challenges with everything we’ve got. 🧑⚕️Everyone can find and afford the health care they need. We must ramp up our mental health and substance abuse treatment capacity, ensuring trained professionals are ready and available to address behavioral health needs. 📚 Every child has a safe place to receive a high-quality public education. We need to build on our work in education and make sure every kid in Oregon has what they need to shine. 🏛️ We stand up for our values. Protecting reproductive rights, the environment, immigrants, and civil rights is simply non-negotiable. [_**That’s the roadmap — and we need focused effort and teamwork to get this done. | | | | Friends,

We wanted to make sure you saw a recent [AP article](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=f385d7f00c&e=33f53a5b1a), welcoming the new co-chairs of the For Country Caucus! We are excited to see what the caucus will accomplish under the leadership of U.S. Navy veteran, Rep. Jake Ellzey, and U.S. Air Force veteran, Rep. Don Davis.

If you haven’t already, check out the article below and share [our tweet](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=64ecefcd1c&e=33f53a5b1a) on social media!
---
|
---
| [**With Honor Action Welcomes New Leadership of the For Country Caucus for the 119th Congress and Announces New Advisory Board Members**](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=ad83e8275c&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
|
---
| _Incoming co-chairs of the For Country Caucus for the 119th Congress, Air Force veteran Rep. Don Davis and Navy veteran Rep. Jake Ellzey._
---
| **WASHINGTON, Jan. 14, 2025 /PRNewswire/** \-- With Honor Action fights polarization in Congress by supporting principled veterans across party lines who take the [With Honor p](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8fc540b984&e=33f53a5b1a)[ledge](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a465cbf995&e=33f53a5b1a) to serve with civility, integrity, and courage. With Honor Action works alongside ten bipartisan U.S. Senators and the [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=28a2add940&e=33f53a5b1a) in the U.S. House of Representatives, a group of 38 U.S. military veterans who work together across party lines to pass important legislation focused on national security, national service, and veterans affairs. “The For Country Caucus is one of the most impactful bipartisan entities in Congress, and I am excited to serve as a co-chair alongside my colleague, Rep. Jake Ellzey. Being part of a caucus of military veterans who share the values of civility and integrity is an incredible experience. I look forward to seeing what we can achieve together in the new Congress,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Air Force veteran Rep. Don Davis. “I am grateful for the opportunity to lead the For Country Caucus alongside my colleague and friend, Rep. Don Davis, for the 119th Congress. Bipartisanship is alive and well here in D.C., and this caucus is a great example of it. The For Country Caucus shows how Members from both sides can work together to find solutions for the American people,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Navy veteran Rep. Jake Ellzey. “The For Country Caucus is one of the last high-impact bipartisan efforts in Congress, and I am excited to accept the co-chair position along with my colleague Rep. Jake Ellzey. It’s been an incredible experience, being a part of a caucus of military veterans who share the same ideals of civility and integrity, and I can’t wait to see what we can accomplish together in the new Congress,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Air Force veteran, Rep. Don Davis. “The For Country Caucus helped pass more than 100 laws in the 118th Congress, with a focus on our two National Defense Authorization Acts (NDAAs). These laws included a major pay raise for our junior enlisted servicemen and women and 17 other key recommendations from the bipartisan Military Quality of Life Panel led by caucus founding Co-Chair Rep. Don Bacon and founding Vice Chair Rep. Chrissy Houlahan. The caucus expanded the number of Special Immigrant Visas for Afghan allies, helped defend Ukraine from Russian aggression, assisted with passing the TikTok “divest or ban” legislation, and helped create a new public-private partnership to counter the exploitation of natural resources by Russia and the Chinese Communist Party in Africa. We are excited to hand the reins over to Rep. Jake Ellzey and Rep. Don Davis and look forward to growing one of the most effective bipartisan and bicameral platforms in Congress,” said U.S. Army veteran, Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, 118th Congress Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus. “It’s been an honor to co-chair the For Country Caucus alongside Rep. Tony Gonzales the last two years. We’ve worked hard to bring veteran values to Washington, build relationships across the aisle, and improve the lives of our servicemembers and their families,” said Rep. Jason Crow, Army veteran and 118th Congress Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus. “The For Country Caucus is the next generation of veteran leadership in Congress, and we welcome Rep. Jake Ellzey and Rep. Don Davis, two distinguished post 9-11 veterans, as co-chairs. As the caucus heads into its seventh year of bipartisan work, I am delighted to see the caucus growing its ranks to deliver even more results on major national security and domestic issues that are too often paralyzed by the polarization in Congress,” said former Secretary of Defense Dr. Robert Gates, a member of the With Honor Action Advisory Board. With Honor Action is also pleased to announce the addition of nine new leaders to our [Advisory Board](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=bd70fb0968&e=33f53a5b1a).
* Emma Bloomberg, Co-Founder and CEO, Murmuration
* John Drew, General Partner, TCV
* Mark Haidar, Founder & Chair, Vinli
* Adam Hanover, CEO, Union Main
* The Honorable Jane Holl Lute, 5th U.S. Deputy Secretary of Homeland Security
* The Honorable Thomas “Mack” McLarty, 17th White House Chief of Staff
* Senator Barabara Mikulski of Maryland (Ret.), former Chair of Senate Appropriations
* Senator Rob Portman of Ohio (Ret.), former Chair of the U.S. Senate Ukraine Caucus
* Bob Sternfels, Global Managing Partner, McKinsey & Company

“Our Advisory Board advances our mission to break partisan gridlock in Congress through principled veteran leadership. There is so much important work to be done together for our nation in the 119th Congress, and it is essential to maintain and grow a place of trust and serious work across party lines, especially as it pertains to our national security,” said Rye Barcott, With Honor Action CEO and Co-Founder.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | | | Friends, We wanted to make sure you saw a recent , welcoming the new co-chairs of the For Country Caucus! We are excited to see what the caucus will accomplish under the leadership of U.S. Navy veteran, Rep. Jake Ellzey, and U.S. Air Force veteran, Rep. Don Davis. If you haven’t already, check out the article below and share on social media! | | | | Incoming co-chairs of the For Country Caucus for the 119th Congress, Air Force veteran Rep. Don Davis and Navy veteran Rep. Jake Ellzey. | WASHINGTON, Jan. 14, 2025 /PRNewswire/ \-- With Honor Action fights polarization in Congress by supporting principled veterans across party lines who take the to serve with civility, integrity, and courage. With Honor Action works alongside ten bipartisan U.S. Senators and the in the U.S. House of Representatives, a group of 38 U.S. military veterans who work together across party lines to pass important legislation focused on national security, national service, and veterans affairs. “The For Country Caucus is one of the most impactful bipartisan entities in Congress, and I am excited to serve as a co-chair alongside my colleague, Rep. Jake Ellzey. Being part of a caucus of military veterans who share the values of civility and integrity is an incredible experience. I look forward to seeing what we can achieve together in the new Congress,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Air Force veteran Rep. Don Davis. “I am grateful for the opportunity to lead the For Country Caucus alongside my colleague and friend, Rep. Don Davis, for the 119th Congress. Bipartisanship is alive and well here in D.C., and this caucus is a great example of it. The For Country Caucus shows how Members from both sides can work together to find solutions for the American people,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Navy veteran Rep. Jake Ellzey. “The For Country Caucus is one of the last high-impact bipartisan efforts in Congress, and I am excited to accept the co-chair position along with my colleague Rep. Jake Ellzey. It’s been an incredible experience, being a part of a caucus of military veterans who share the same ideals of civility and integrity, and I can’t wait to see what we can accomplish together in the new Congress,” said incoming For Country Caucus Co-Chair and Air Force veteran, Rep. Don Davis. “The For Country Caucus helped pass more than 100 laws in the 118th Congress, with a focus on our two National Defense Authorization Acts (NDAAs). These laws included a major pay raise for our junior enlisted servicemen and women and 17 other key recommendations from the bipartisan Military Quality of Life Panel led by caucus founding Co-Chair Rep. Don Bacon and founding Vice Chair Rep. Chrissy Houlahan. The caucus expanded the number of Special Immigrant Visas for Afghan allies, helped defend Ukraine from Russian aggression, assisted with passing the TikTok “divest or ban” legislation, and helped create a new public-private partnership to counter the exploitation of natural resources by Russia and the Chinese Communist Party in Africa. We are excited to hand the reins over to Rep. Jake Ellzey and Rep. Don Davis and look forward to growing one of the most effective bipartisan and bicameral platforms in Congress,” said U.S. Army veteran, Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, 118th Congress Vice Chair of the For Country Caucus. “It’s been an honor to co-chair the For Country Caucus alongside Rep. Tony Gonzales the last two years. We’ve worked hard to bring veteran values to Washington, build relationships across the aisle, and improve the lives of our servicemembers and their families,” said Rep. Jason Crow, Army veteran and 118th Congress Co-Chair of the For Country Caucus. “The For Country Caucus is the next generation of veteran leadership in Congress, and we welcome Rep. Jake Ellzey and Rep. Don Davis, two distinguished post 9-11 veterans, as co-chairs. As the caucus heads into its seventh year of bipartisan work, I am delighted to see the caucus growing its ranks to deliver even more results on major national security and domestic issues that are too often paralyzed by the polarization in Congress,” said former Secretary of Defense Dr. Robert Gates, a member of the With Honor Action Advisory Board. With Honor Action is also pleased to announce the addition of nine new leaders to our . Friend, More people live in Los Angeles County than in most U.S. states, and millions of residents are still struggling with toxic smoke, in addition to thousands who’ve lost their homes in the ongoing fires. As fires still burn, nearly 100,000 people are still under evacuation orders, and intense winds are picking back up this week. With little protection from the dangerous air, unhoused residents are still facing cruel city-led sweeps that destroy the few belongings they do have. Mutual aid groups are stepping up to serve the community, connecting displaced people with housing support and distributing much-needed survival supplies like food, water, and protective equipment such as N95 masks. **Right now, the Mutual Aid Los Angeles Network is playing an essential role, connecting over 100 mutual aid efforts that are providing essential services and doing direct work on the ground in their neighborhoods.** For years, the Mutual Aid LA Network has coordinated a group directory and connected mutual aid groups, people in need of resources, and well-resourced people with each other. The network also runs its own programs to support unhoused and under-resourced LA residents—such as weekly food distribution and regular events to build and distribute hygiene kits. **The network is a vital information hub that’s already built important expertise and connections, which are especially needed now.** For example, the volunteer team partners with LA Community Fridges, so when they heard that many local shelters were overwhelmed with donations, the team pivoted to directing people to distribute resources to community fridges throughout the city. [**In this time of crisis, will you donate what you can to the Mutual Aid Los Angeles Network, so they can keep purchasing and sharing survival supplies while redistributing most funds to smaller mutual aid efforts and to individual LA residents in need?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.SLdqY4re9NRChJwFnQ0ir4tOw2XR5ec6-ldcVEWIc6Y-QWclsT29iuyOgLUXMESmNMzSgRP8lb8OE9y9C7yiWLFJGAqkHajplHvgC0n9P9DXJF1GjB93YqZ9r5qy6jfRAefh1nYrWa-BunBENqjQrO64DcBVb4wrpn7OYNoNTuGcVPmxO-9R7rjK-pvogRXiHryl8uN01ontdAeopBYePHktX1Yq-y4HX2ex7anGw_MzMGjoV-hrnVbqJYoOvLvJ5Pwh3GZhnWqseMTmzmNO8mNdZpRMGEi1FPrc24GQTPxUBlRIMWLCIeseUYXbrTnd/4d7/KVIo1WrwQ1yweaTtFg69gA/h1/h001.Te4st-fcElR8MF5KSe13BcriB8mcYLlv7RIGuhFSrUU) | [DONATE NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.SLdqY4re9NRChJwFnQ0ir4tOw2XR5ec6-ldcVEWIc6Y-QWclsT29iuyOgLUXMESm1h2t30htvAqMuEGd5EMgV_DmwbVtNdXX_sJ9ajWV4IDlSnVG8v01OkV0DCQV7--m6v0-kUaQ6tOOvqfjluoOP-mI_1OoxNo-xIblqySdSNW50APmNj_mUvayE6RV9RjdFmpey-oOcaCFvwomP1-3loKa7-aVbm1UXKT7p-XYcHCP40G7uDGrOhlmVOeulmp1giiKnxES45vhRcgh6bfw40cZZVnHULjS0b3xrI6SxSuuBKL8IYGhvi9nAfedOLbb/4d7/KVIo1WrwQ1yweaTtFg69gA/h2/h001.ZGp5QAo0O_hygRvbJ08wiLQSOGK4Y2j96h_fipf-o_U)

Thank you so much. Together, we can help the community-led groups that are on the ground, already running clothing drives and community clean-ups, supporting seniors and people with disabilities who need evacuation and housing, coordinating pet housing and care, providing medical care and medical supplies, and more.
With more strong winds picking up this week, the conditions are set for ongoing fire spread. Right now, the Mutual Aid Los Angeles Network is playing an essential role, connecting over 100 mutual aid efforts that are providing essential services and doing direct work on the ground in their neighborhoods. The network also runs its own programs to support unhoused and under-resourced LA residents—such as weekly food distribution and regular events to build and distribute hygiene kits. The network is a vital information hub that’s already built important expertise and connections, which are especially needed now. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508468/522995548/2145945666?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442) | Peter, Welcome to the latest edition of Emily’s Notes — updates from Congress and the campaign trail! Here’s what I’ve been up to: • On January 3, I was officially sworn in as a member of Congress! One of the first things I did that day was cast a vote for Democratic Majority Leader Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker of the House. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508469/522995549/12552308?hl=en&img_index=2&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442) While MAGA Mike Johnson eked out a narrow win, the experience showed how close the margins are in the House, especially as a few members leave to join the Trump administration. If there’s a bad bill that hurts working people, we only need to convince a few Republicans to sink it. Stay tuned. • We’ve gotten a lot of press attention for our historic win in 2024, and I’ve done a number of interviews with outlets like [_**_The Advocate_**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508470/522995550/329507148?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442) and [_**NBC News**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508471/522995551/-1424437716?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442). But one of my favorite conversations was with Deja Foxx of Gen-Z Girl Gang, which shares news and builds community for young women online — [_**check out the video!**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508472/522995552/2098223344?hl=en&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442) • On Monday, I gave an overview of the last few days in Congress while slicing onions and sweet potatoes for dinner. It’s gotten a great response on Instagram! [_**Please watch and let me know if you’d like to see more cooking and policy chats in the future.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508473/522995553/-1214287305?hl=en&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442) _**[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508474/522995554/-1214287305?hl=en&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442)**_ • Some positive news: _**[Thanks to the Biden Administration, medical debt will no longer appear on credit reports](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100508475/522995555/-832511852?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.01.16_JanNewsletter_Exp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDVjN2NmNS01M2Q0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6pOJU-Z5APa7kGidRTWOV9xoFveHQcNaCX34TSUwfFk=&emci=a21836a4-5ad3-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=fd5c7cf5-53d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=23483442)**_ , where they can block people from getting mortgages, car loans, or small business loans. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1011&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ][IMG]

Peter Willis, Trump’s
“Energy Dominance” plans are horrifying. And they start on Monday.

As soon as he’s sworn in, Trump plans to immediately roll back climate
protections, drill on federal lands, weaken EV standards, and withdraw
from the Paris Climate Agreement.

His stated goals just get worse from there — but we aren’t powerless to
stop him. Bernie, Our Revolution, and our coalition are working every
angle to block Trump’s most anti-planet ambitions. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1012&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ]Add your name: Stand
against Trump’s dangerous Fossil Fuel Agenda now.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1013&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ][IMG]

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21086?t=1014&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ]ADD YOUR NAME

The stakes couldn’t be higher. As deadly fires rage through Los Angeles,
Trump’s agenda will accelerate the climate crisis, push working families
to the brink, and devastate the progress we’ve fought so hard to achieve.

Activists and allies are already showing up in the Senate to protest
Trump’s terrible nominee for Secretary of Energy, Chris Wright — a literal
fracking CEO who testified before the Senate that “fossil-fueled climate
change isn’t an accelerant for intense wildfire storms.”

And TODAY, Bernie Sanders just GRILLED Trump’s EPA nominee, Lee Zeldin,
and got him to contradict Trump’s claim that “climate change is a hoax.”

This is the inside-outside energy WE need to bring to this fight against
Trump and the oil oligarchs. And we have to show up every step of the way.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1015&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ]Add your name — stand with Bernie, Our Revolution, and our national
action team for climate defense in this crucial movement.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1016&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ][IMG]

Trump feels tough spouting off “drill baby drill,” but he’s really just
doing the dirty work for the fossil fuel billionaires who helped buy his
re-election. Pathetic.

These same corporations spent decades burying climate science, lobbying
against clean energy, and profiting at the expense of our communities. But
they’ve overplayed their hand.

The American people want an end to climate chaos. Anger and frustration
are rising with each devastating fire, flood, and superstorm that no one
should ever have to suffer. Our Revolution has the strategy, the tools and
the team to organize that energy into action.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1017&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ]Are you with us? We’ve got Bernie and elected officials in the
progressive caucus working with our growing outside coalition — now we
need an army of committed citizens willing to take a stand. Click here to
add your name today.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21134?t=1018&akid=7542%2E5885482%2Eb6CDce ]ADD YOUR NAME

Thank you for all that you do. We are in this together.

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

Oregon has a great opportunity to continue to be a leader on climate action this year. Take action now!| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508617/522996078/-1711949704?contactdata=KgZDas8PSjphTP9PRpQJYlFVirEV+bsrvqXhv7HNZoqf/p9rfZc7P+zWCNlJMW44rtPTYuSBozBwmpS8e6m2LS9lAJ0AU1V6xkGt6uDkXZAQqZNxW96tVtoA7ZwwZv1p&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230)

Hi Peter, Oregon’s 2025 legislative session begins on Tuesday, January 21st, but I’ve already started meeting with legislators and partners to ensure we’re doing all we can to pass strong pro-climate and pro-environment legislation this year. As promised, here is a summary of OLCV’s and Oregon Conservation Network’s (OCN) priorities for this session! We anticipate that we’ll have to do a fair amount of defense this session on progress we’ve already made, but there’s still a lot we can accomplish. As always, **passing strong pro-climate and pro-conservation budgets remain one of our top priorities**. Under Trump’s leadership it will be up to Oregon’s state government to ensure funding for our state’s programs that protect our climate, air, water, forests and wildlife. On top of that, OLCV and OCN have selected three priority packages for this session:
* **A transportation package that prioritizes climate, equity, and wildlife:** This package would build on the historic gains on HB 2017 (which included investments in public transit, Safe Routes to School, and vehicle electrification), to shift the focus to multimodal, safety, and climate-forward investments. This will create a system that saves money over time and builds a more resilient, equitable, and healthy future for all Oregonians.
* **Energy Affordability and Utility Accountability** **(**[**HB 3081**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508618/522996079/-1636620635?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230)**,**[**SB 88**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508619/522996080/-1804391104?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230)**, LC 1547):** Oregonians are struggling to keep up with skyrocketing utility bills in the face of ever-worsening climate impacts. [**HB 3081**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508620/522996081/-1636620635?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230) would create an active navigator to help Oregonians access energy efficiency incentives all in one place. [**SB 88**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508621/522996082/-1804391104?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230) limits the ability of utility companies from charging ratepayers for lobbying, litigation costs, fines, marketing, industry fees, and political spending. **LC 1547** ensures that large energy users (i.e. data centers) do not unfairly burden Oregon households.
* **Safeguarding Streamflows to Protect Oregon's Water (**[**SB 427**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508622/522996083/-1616786958?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230)**):** OCN members have introduced [**SB 427**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508623/522996084/-1616786958?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230), which tackles an outdated regulatory loophole in our water right transfer laws that effectively nullifies Oregon’s ability to protect streamflows on the vast majority of streams across the state. OCN members are also actively shaping the 2025 House water package to make it more environmentally friendly.

It’s worth mentioning that we have also included a special focus area for this session with the **Wildlife Stewardship Program** ([**HB 2980**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100508624/522996085/-879906294?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImFiZDU5YzE2LTU1ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=l8rjEuM0Y0bIOiIEYFaqlWe-fICpEZuR07c8XZGLX2Q=&emci=f1085625-45d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=abd59c16-55d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=2107230)) to honor Bob Sallingar’s legacy.

clean_body: We can't let them turn their backs on California... | = | Did you see this? With Southern Californians grieving and much of Los Angeles facing fire, Speaker Johnson is threatening to condition aid to California in our time of need. And he’s not the only one. Republican Senator Tommy Tuberville went on national TV saying that because California elects Democrats statewide, “They don't deserve anything to be honest with you.” Shelter shouldn’t come with strings. Food and water shouldn’t come with strings. Rebuilding our communities and restoring hope to countless Californians should not come with strings. Our survivors and first responders deserve support from the federal government — and under President Biden, we’ve received it. President Biden has announced that for the next six months, the federal government will cover 100% of the cost of measures to protect lives and property in Southern California. But now many leading Republicans are openly discussing limiting or conditioning future aid — all because they don’t like our elected officials. That is wrong. Thank you so much for speaking up at this incredibly urgent time. — CADEM HQ | | = Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. Rep. Nancy Mace **[EXPLODED at Democrat Rep. Jasmine Crockett,](https://substack.com/redirect/9b511c3b-3b0d-4daa-b829-b4ce544d2c37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** appearing to challenge her to a fight during a tense hearing on transgender rights.

"Somebody's campaign coffers are struggling right now," Crockett quipped towards Mace. "So she gonna keep saying 'trans, trans trans' so that people will feel threatened,... Child, listen..."
Mace, fiercely fired back, "I am no child! Do not call me a child!"
"I have broken more glass ceilings in my lifetime than you ever will! I am not a child!" she continued. "If you wanna take it outside we can do that!!"

# Thanking my longtime friend, President Donald J. Trump

Trump posted a message of support for Giuliani, Sunday on Truth Social.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZOtbasmYU28Ngpm7re9UczwRx_QjaM0nQNyqHsGsOyY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=154975727)
In these tumultuous times, when so many in the political press and within the Democrat Party seem to be teaming up against me, it's comforting to know that I have friends who stand by me, unconditionally. I want to take this moment to express my deepest gratitude to Donald J. Trump, a man I've known for decades, and who has recently shown his unwavering support by posting "SAVE RUDY" on Truth Social.
Firstly, let me say, Mr. President, your gesture means more to me than you could possibly know. It's not just about the post; it's about the message it sends. It's about loyalty, something that's been the bedrock of our relationship from the very start. When I was the Mayor of New York City, you were there whenever we needed you. You understand the city's pulse, just as I did. We've walked through the streets of Manhattan together, not just as two New Yorkers, but as friends who shared a vision for a better, safer city...

This week’s Senate confirmation hearings have made one thing painfully clear: **Trump has nominated a Cabinet of sycophants who will turn a blind eye to science, justice, and democracy itself.** **[His dangerous nominees can’t go unchallenged. Will you donate today to help us fight back against their reckless agenda?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/100509501/522999342/2105508926?refcode=ea.9e57367e-57d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.9e57367e-57d4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjllNTczNjdlLTU3ZDQtZWYxMS04OGQwLTAwMjI0ODJhOWQ5MiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=f064SyG02_2RWjxkhwvgNkzupo-yxjh-hOiABn_zKKM=)** Let’s talk about the worst of the worst: Trump’s energy and environmental nominees — _the fossil fuel trio of doom:_ ❌ **Doug Burgum (Interior Secretary):** Burgum’s ties to the fossil fuel industry, including personal royalties from oil leases and campaign contributions from top oil companies, leave no doubt where his loyalties lie. As governor of North Dakota, he oversaw a massive expansion of drilling in the state. If confirmed, Burgum will oversee drilling on federal land and hand Big Oil the keys. ❌ **Chris Wright (Energy Secretary):** Wright is the CEO of Liberty Energy, a fracking company, and one of Trump’s staunchest allies in pushing fossil fuels at all costs. At his confirmation hearing, Wright vowed to implement Trump’s “bold energy agenda,” a plan that prioritizes more drilling, rolling back climate protections, and ignoring the escalating climate crisis. His loyalty lies with the oil and gas industry — not the environment, and not us. ❌ **Lee Zeldin (EPA Administrator):** Zeldin’s _abysmal 14% lifetime score from the League of Conservation Voters in Congress_ just goes to show how he has spent his career rolling back environmental protections. If confirmed, he’ll be primed to dismantle decades of progress at the EPA, turning it into a playground for polluters. And it doesn’t stop there. Trump is handing the Department of Defense to Pete Hegseth, a Fox News personality with no relevant experience. His pick for Attorney General, Pam Bondi, is best known for her close ties to Trump himself, having served as one of his lawyers during his first impeachment trial. And don’t forget John Ratcliffe (_CIA Director_) and reality television star Sean Duffy (_Secretary of Transportation_), whose records make it clear they are there to serve Trump’s personal interests, not the American people. Let’s be honest: Senate Republicans will confirm them. We know it, and so does Trump. clean_body: Meet the wrecking crew → | This week’s Senate confirmation hearings have made one thing painfully clear: Trump has nominated a Cabinet of sycophants who will turn a blind eye to science, justice, and democracy itself. = Let’s talk about the worst of the worst: Trump’s energy and environmental nominees — the fossil fuel trio of doom: ❌ Doug Burgum (Interior Secretary): Burgum’s ties to the fossil fuel industry, including personal royalties from oil leases and campaign contributions from top oil companies, leave no doubt where his loyalties lie. As governor of North Dakota, he oversaw a massive expansion of drilling in the state. If confirmed, Burgum will oversee drilling on federal land and hand Big Oil the keys. ❌ Chris Wright (Energy Secretary): Wright is the CEO of Liberty Energy, a fracking company, and one of Trump’s staunchest allies in pushing fossil fuels at all costs. At his confirmation hearing, Wright vowed to implement Trump’s “bold energy agenda,” a plan that prioritizes more drilling, rolling back climate protections, and ignoring the escalating climate crisis. His loyalty lies with the oil and gas industry — not the environment, and not us. ❌ Lee Zeldin (EPA Administrator): Zeldin’s abysmal 14% lifetime score from the League of Conservation Voters in Congress just goes to show how he has spent his career rolling back environmental protections. If confirmed, he’ll be primed to dismantle decades of progress at the EPA, turning it into a playground for polluters. And it doesn’t stop there. Trump is handing the Department of Defense to Pete Hegseth, a Fox News personality with no relevant experience. His pick for Attorney General, Pam Bondi, is best known for her close ties to Trump himself, having served as one of his lawyers during his first impeachment trial. name: Pastor Paula White
subject: This is a new era
body:
| | | | [](https://https//national-faith-advisory-board.revv.co/inauguration-card-fls?utm_medium=email&utm_source=dp_lr&utm_campaign=f8db3cff&recurring=true&xuno=464c35353531&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901)
---
Peter,
As we stand on the brink of a new era, let us unite in a powerful demonstration of faith and conviction. President Trump has consistently championed our community, defending religious freedom and promoting values that resonate deeply with our beliefs. Now, more than ever, we must show him our unwavering support.
[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](https://https//national-faith-advisory-board.revv.co/inauguration-card-fls?utm_medium=email&utm_source=dp_lr&utm_campaign=f8db3cff&recurring=true&xuno=464c35353531&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901)

We need 2,486 more Patriots to show President Trump they still stand with him. Will I see your name at the top of the top of the list?

[YES!](https://https//national-faith-advisory-board.revv.co/inauguration-card-fls?utm_medium=email&utm_source=dp_lr&utm_campaign=f8db3cff&recurring=true&xuno=464c35353531&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901)
I invite you to add your name to a growing list of fervent believers who are committed to standing with President Trump. Our mission is clear: to ensure that people of faith remain a formidable force in shaping the future of our nation. By uniting under the banner of the National Faith Advisory Board, we can amplify our voices and make a resounding impact.
We are running out of time before the Inauguration, so make sure your name is on the list before the biggest day of the year. **[Add your name>>](https://https//national-faith-advisory-board.revv.co/inauguration-card-fls?utm_medium=email&utm_source=dp_lr&utm_campaign=f8db3cff&recurring=true&xuno=464c35353531&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901)**
Together, we can create generational change and safeguard the principles we hold dear. Your participation is crucial in this pivotal moment. Let us pray fervently for our leaders, our nation, and for God's guidance in these times.
[STAND WITH PRESIDENT TRUMP](https://https//national-faith-advisory-board.revv.co/inauguration-card-fls?utm_medium=email&utm_source=dp_lr&utm_campaign=f8db3cff&recurring=true&xuno=464c35353531&utm_term=aegean&xunv=aegean&xutm=02002901)

Join us in this vital mission. Add your name today and be counted among those who are unafraid to stand boldly for their beliefs. Together, we can inspire a future that honors our faith and strengthens our country.
In faith and unity,
Pastor Paula WhiteNational Faith Advisory Board

Apopka, FL 32703
