name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Turn America back to Godly values
body:
There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=45ac016da28f40499da4f7edc835de59&_e=xaMdd-bMgq0F4yHuee59J4iB3x-9Vd9Fnt2bCtM1dT1CQAj4nQipYGh8b_uythh7otHTwDFUBO7UJCs_R6-woaRg5Ryom9DHfFk6Mqh7K7809YNIRc63tp6G-3cJlO8EcG4alg26BPlz_ZBYvoLBLq96The9KnHAPnLTx6GS43DElivgAnF61H5HjfWnfN1l_iP2CHV7AjrBHOBOGBGn2RhsaePwBWMbjPsklsGC8sQOds0DN9-3kxT86ag0i6JiK2J5xAZ0zlE2hhkuIS4ZauNlx2putqqYqIUNpFwGjPH850o2AYR6kyXXNNqa4IqjwS-7xpWEYvrqE_j1AeL45WRl8xuwrq6iuo1SqFJM_4GeEfBDofYP1hwxUP5KFP1E)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=45ac016da28f40499da4f7edc835de59&_e=xaMdd-bMgq0F4yHuee59J4iB3x-9Vd9Fnt2bCtM1dT1CQAj4nQipYGh8b_uythh7otHTwDFUBO7UJCs_R6-woaRg5Ryom9DHfFk6Mqh7K7809YNIRc63tp6G-3cJlO8EcG4alg26BPlz_ZBYvoLBLq96The9KnHAPnLTx6GS43DElivgAnF61H5HjfWnfN1l_iP2CHV7AjrBHOBOGBGn2RhsaePwBWMbjPsklsGC8sS9E0ODORiKaijdGOSenPIvvIPZ9pVK6klePXCz24iOgi-SkuDxTCQSB0Kc0BATvuTH2pJ5vEUHc4cLYIU4YDQKRQ2M8vpz2nXCTDJEeZuc4tFDNsLHBqwuDXI44dvPu0e5Jd1awUoSKhTnBeRl9_pf)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=45ac016da28f40499da4f7edc835de59&_e=xaMdd-bMgq0F4yHuee59J4iB3x-9Vd9Fnt2bCtM1dT1CQAj4nQipYGh8b_uythh7otHTwDFUBO7UJCs_R6-woaRg5Ryom9DHfFk6Mqh7K7809YNIRc63tp6G-3cJlO8EcG4alg26BPlz_ZBYvoLBLq96The9KnHAPnLTx6GS43DElivgAnF61H5HjfWnfN1l_iP2CHV7AjrBHOBOGBGn2RhsaePwBWMbjPsklsGC8sSex7y-xaMxeT2F07_V9wmj5aOH59PtvC0uHzVSbpDtMWO3tl9qC9wvRROfdF1-htyC4lTR8Ky-dorsQ7zsp-U14DEh39SvPAldvFGJGhwgAMP_N_Yxy0fSJuaXM91QiDeNZha6XVMG8boIb-jq7_w1) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=45ac016da28f40499da4f7edc835de59&_e=xaMdd-bMgq0F4yHuee59J4iB3x-9Vd9Fnt2bCtM1dT1CQAj4nQipYGh8b_uythh7otHTwDFUBO7UJCs_R6-woaRg5Ryom9DHfFk6Mqh7K7809YNIRc63tp6G-3cJlO8EcG4alg26BPlz_ZBYvoLBLq96The9KnHAPnLTx6GS43DElivgAnF61H5HjfWnfN1l_iP2CHV7AjrBHOBOGBGn2RhsaePwBWMbjPsklsGC8sRHL3An5minIz5IngO65rGK0s9XxBh9gzKdmf6Gm_LKpQhbe9u9mHURbzrKu3u0ue5sM47-aH4qkF8WAp0UGZmjUGoud59CwEm4OniP_sEMFkyGAGBrH4SF9jeI5NqKfcz-Fc_uz0k-IHaxgLKMRgbV)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. # [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/100511549/523005262/823540626?refcode=ea.cae9eb7b-5fd4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ms=ea.cae9eb7b-5fd4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYWU5ZWI3Yi01ZmQ0LWVmMTEtODhkMC0wMDIyNDgyYTlkOTIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Q94X0WPjK4Z5tjPr4q5H-20DpiZdmrW6LB7PEXDo2lQ=&emci=cc7c7dc9-4fd4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&emdi=cae9eb7b-5fd4-ef11-88d0-0022482a9d92&ceid=1049176)
Peter, as Americans, we are promised that our voices will be heard at the ballot box and that our votes have meaning. If the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Supreme Court succeeds in his efforts to toss out tens of thousands of legal ballots, that promise will be broken. **It’s unacceptable.** Our Democratic candidate, Justice Allison Riggs, won her re-election campaign. Two recounts confirmed it. North Carolina’s elections _must_ mean something — and these election results should be certified so Justice Riggs can get back to work serving all North Carolinians. I’m deeply concerned that the right-wing majority on the NC Supreme Court may have already decided to bow to the Republican Party and the losing Republican candidate, rather than uphold the will of the people. They should have no further role in adjudicating this election, and in fact, this case should never have been brought in the first place. body:
People like you will be critical to making our shared progressive vision a reality.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250116-4677-footer&t=1&akid=4677%2E420207%2EEleeb2)
Peter, Donald Trump takes office again in just four days, but it’s never too early to be thinking about what our politics is going to look like when he’s gone.
**The next time Democrats hold power, we need to act fast to pass a bold, populist, working class agenda that people can feel in their everyday lives:**
👩🏽⚕️ Medicare for All
👶 Paid family and medical leave
💵 Raising the federal minimum wage
👷🏽 Strengthening labor unions
Embracing that kind of transformative agenda is the only way to win back the trust of the working class voters who we lost or stayed home in 2024.
**But insurance companies, Big Pharma, and others rely on the current system to bring in record profits at the expense of working people.**
And since **big corporations and billionaires spend hundreds of millions every year through super PACs** to elect politicians who will continue to do their bidding, grassroots contributions from people like you will be critical to making our shared progressive vision a reality.
[**That’s why today, we’re asking you to become a 2025 Member of Pramila’s campaign by pitching in $3 or whatever you can to help us grow our progressive movement in the months ahead.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250116?refcode=em20250116-4677&amount=3&refcode2=4677_420207_Eleeb2&akid=4677%2E420207%2EEleeb2)

Thank you for your support, Peter. We truly can’t do it without you.
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

THANK YOU for your support, encouragement, donations, and volunteer hours – because of you we were able to re-elect Pat last November. Our grassroots support was overwhelming and helped Pat win re-election to continue representing us in Congress. However, despite Pat's win, at the Presidential level, the district performed 6.7% worse than it did in 2020, with Vice President Harris winning the district by just 2.5%. This is still one of the closest seats in the country and will be a crucial frontline race as we head into 2026. Our team invested all of the contributions we received from supporters like you to secure Pat's win, and now we need to rebuild our war chest to ensure we hold this seat in 2026. Folks,

I’m excited to announce that I’ve officially launched my re-election campaign to represent Massachusetts’ 6th Congressional District.

Over the years, we’ve worked together to take on the tough fights, but there’s one battle ahead that’s even more important: making sure the Democratic Party can communicate effectively and rebuild our efforts to fight for everyday Americans.

As you know, the decisive re-election of Donald Trump reminds us that our country is at a crossroads. People are frustrated with how Washington works — and rightfully so. People are also frustrated with the Democratic Party. There’s a feeling that politicians are more focused on rhetoric than actually solving the problems that matter most.

That’s why I’ve always said that we need to communicate better and fight for the issues that working Americans care about — better wages, quality healthcare, affordable housing, and a fair shot for anyone who wants it.

But here’s the reality: As I begin my campaign, I know that I’m facing the likely scenario of multiple candidates challenging me in the primary. That’s what happens when you’re fighting for change — not everyone will agree with you.

However, I believe that we can only move forward if we remain united behind the values that matter most.

That’s why I’m asking for your support right now. Together, we can make sure the message stays clear: We need a stronger, more united Democratic Party that stands unapologetically for working Americans and communicates that vision to every corner of our country.

Can you chip in today to help me continue this fight? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/seth-moulton-3]

Thank you for standing with me as we push forward. The work we do in the coming months is going to be critical — not just for me, but for all of us.

Onward,

Seth Moulton

body:
It’s time to end scam credit repair.
#
Last week, Sarah introduced her _first_ bill in Congress — less than a week from getting the keys to her office (talk about hitting the ground running)!
Her bipartisan bill, the **Ending Scam Credit Repair Act** (ESCRA), will crack down on scammers in the so-called “credit repair” industry.
[**Now, Sarah needs your help in building support. Will you add your name as a grassroots co-sponsor of the Ending Scam Credit Repair Act?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-escra-sign-on/?source=em20250116-1697&akid=1697%2E21716%2EWZHcL3)
**Here’s the problem:**
For too long, the credit repair industry has been scamming Delawareans and folks across the county with low credit scores by promising easy credit fixes.
They exploit legal loopholes to target cash-trapped people, charging large upfront fees based on false hopes of debt reduction.
**Here’s the solution:**
Sarah’s legislation will ban upfront fees, improve transparency, and enhance consumer protections — eliminating the loopholes that have allowed these predatory practices to flourish.
**ESCRA will protect consumers by ending scam credit repair, but Sarah can’t pass this legislation alone.**
[**Can you sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor to say you support this critical consumer protection bill?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-escra-sign-on/?source=em20250116-1697&akid=1697%2E21716%2EWZHcL3)
